title: Task-State Governance: A Virtual Machine for Verifiable and Recoverable GUI Agent Execution

paragraphs.en: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents now execute workflows across real applications, but when execution drifts, users must determine what changed, what should have remained untouched, and what can still be recovered. Plan-centric interfaces leave users supervising procedure, but users live with changes to application state. We introduce task-state governance , an interaction paradigm that represents a task as an editable contract linking desired outcomes, facts that must be preserved, and observed application state. We instantiate this paradigm in TaskVM , which projects live state into editable task controls, executes user edits as genuine interface actions, verifies outcomes through independent observation, and marks each action as reversible, compensatable, or irreversible. Across an automated contract benchmark, a controlled user study, and an open live-model exploration, the paradigm strengthened contract compliance and users’ recovery control and trust, while execution outcomes were held constant. Task contracts open a design space for governable agent interfaces.
paragraphs.zh: 图形用户界面（GUI）智能体如今可以在真实应用程序中执行工作流，但当执行过程出现偏差时，用户必须确定哪些内容发生了变化、哪些内容本应保持不变，以及哪些内容仍然可以恢复。 以计划为中心的界面让用户监督流程，但用户仍需应对应用程序状态的变化。 我们提出了任务状态治理——一种交互范式，它将任务表示为一个可编辑的契约，该契约连接了期望的结果、必须保留的事实以及观察到的应用程序状态。 我们在 TaskVM 中实现了这一范式：它将实时状态投射到可编辑的任务控制中，将用户的编辑作为真实的界面操作执行，通过独立观察验证结果，并将每个操作标记为可逆、可补偿或不可逆的。 在一项自动化契约基准测试、一项受控用户研究以及一次开放的真实模型探索中，该范式增强了契约合规性、用户的恢复控制能力和信任度，同时执行结果保持不变。 任务契约为可治理的智能体界面开辟了新的设计空间。

paragraphs.en: Consider postponing a project briefing by one day. The calendar entry and the team announcement must change, while a settled flight booking must remain untouched, and a collaborator may request a different date midway through execution. A revised plan does not, by itself, say which updates have already taken effect, which records must stay protected, and which effects can no longer be undone. As Figure 1 illustrates, users ultimately live with changes to the world, not with changes to an agent’s plan.
paragraphs.zh: 考虑将项目简报推迟一天。 日历条目和团队公告必须更改，而已确定的航班预订则必须保持不变，同时合作者可能在执行过程中要求更改日期。 仅凭修订后的计划本身，无法说明哪些更新已经生效、哪些记录必须受到保护，以及哪些影响已无法撤销。 如图 1 所示，用户最终需要适应世界的变化，而不是智能体计划的变化。

paragraphs.en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) have made this delegation technically plausible at scale. Modern agents parse complex layouts, synthesize input gestures, and execute extended operational sequences across unfamiliar interfaces ( OpenAI, 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ; Deng et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2024 ; Rawles et al., 2025 ) . Interaction research has responded by opening execution up for oversight: co-planning surfaces let users revise procedural steps, ambient displays communicate agent status, and malleable or generative interfaces reorganize the workspace around the task ( Feng et al., 2026 ; Huq et al., 2025 ; Venkatesan et al., 2026 ; Chang et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Jiang and Xia, 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Cao et al., 2025 ) . These designs make the agent’s procedure the object of interaction: what the user inspects and edits is what the agent will attempt next.
paragraphs.zh: 计算机使用智能体（CUAs）使这种委托在大规模场景下具备了技术上的可行性。 现代智能体能解析复杂布局、合成输入手势，并在不熟悉的用户界面中执行复杂的操作序列（OpenAI, 2025；Cheng 等, 2024；Lin 等, 2025；Zheng 等, 2024；Deng 等, 2023；He 等, 2024；Rawles 等, 2025）。 交互研究则通过引入监督机制作出回应：协同规划界面允许用户修改流程步骤，环境显示屏可传达智能体的状态，而可塑形或生成式界面则能围绕任务重新组织工作空间（Feng 等, 2026；Huq 等, 2025；Venkatesan 等, 2026；Chang 等, 2026；Kim 等, 2026；Jiang 和 Xia, 2026；Xu 等, 2026；Cao 等, 2025）。 这些设计使智能体的操作流程成为交互的对象：用户所查看和编辑的内容，正是智能体接下来将要尝试执行的操作。

paragraphs.en: Two gaps persist in this procedure-centric stance. First, editing a step changes what the agent will attempt, but it cannot express what the world must keep: boundaries on side effects, records that must remain untouched, and facts that should outlive the current plan have no representation in a list of actions. Second, completion and recovery rest on the agent’s own account. When the executor’s report is the only evidence, users cannot verify what actually changed, and undo is offered without a model of which effects can be restored, inviting the over-reliance that supervisory control research has long documented ( Bainbridge, 1983 ; Parasuraman and Riley, 1997 ; Parasuraman and Manzey, 2010 ; Lee and See, 2004 ) . Both gaps follow from one representational choice: the task is modeled as a sequence of actions, so the obligations attached to its outcome have nowhere to live.
paragraphs.zh: 这种以流程为中心的方法仍然存在两个缺陷。 首先，编辑某个步骤会改变智能体将要尝试的操作，但它无法表达世界必须保留的内容：副作用的边界、必须保持原样的记录，以及应当超越当前计划持续存在的事实，在动作列表中都没有体现。 其次，任务的完成和恢复都依赖于智能体自身的说明。 当执行者的报告是唯一证据时，用户无法验证实际发生了哪些变化，而撤销功能也缺乏关于哪些影响可以被恢复的模型支持，这容易引发过度依赖的问题——这一问题在监督控制研究中早已有明确记录（Bainbridge, 1983；Parasuraman and Riley, 1997；Parasuraman and Manzey, 2010；Lee and See, 2004）。 这两个缺陷都源于同一个表示选择：任务被建模为一系列动作，因此与其结果相关的义务便无处安放。

sents.zh: 这种以流程为中心的方法仍然存在两个缺陷。

paragraphs.en: Our stance extends a lineage of work that treats the object, not the procedure, as the unit of interaction. Direct manipulation established that users reason about visible objects of interest ( Shneiderman, 1983 ; Hutchins et al., 1985 ) ; undo research made recovery a first-class design concern ( Abowd and Dix, 1992 ; Myers and Kosbie, 1996 ) ; and accountability research argued that systems should expose what they did so that people can judge it ( Bellotti and Edwards, 2001 ; Suchman, 1995 ) . We extend this lineage from artifacts the user operates to agents that operate on the user’s behalf. We call the resulting stance task-state governance: a task is represented as an editable contract among three state components, not as a procedure alone. The desired state holds the target values the user authorizes the agent to establish. The preservation scope pins application facts that must remain undisturbed. The observed state captures what running applications currently display. When the three are represented together, an edit becomes a checkable commitment: the system knows what it must establish, what it must not disturb, and what evidence will count as done. The plan remains useful, but as one revisable realization of the contract rather than as the task itself.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的立场延续了这样一种研究传统：将对象而非过程视为交互的基本单位。 直接操控方法确立了用户对可见的兴趣对象进行推理（Shneiderman，1983；Hutchins 等，1985）；撤销研究使恢复成为了一级设计问题（Abowd 和 Dix，1992；Myers 和 Kosbie，1996）；而问责制研究则主张系统应揭示其执行的操作，以便用户能够进行判断（Bellotti 和 Edwards，2001；Suchman，1995）。 我们将这一研究传统从用户操作的实体扩展到了代表用户执行操作的智能体。 我们将由此产生的立场称为“任务状态治理”：任务被表示为三个状态组件之间可编辑的契约，而不仅仅是一个孤立的过程。 期望状态包含用户授权智能体所设定的目标值。 保留范围界定了必须保持不受干扰的应用程序事实。 观察状态记录了当前运行应用程序所显示的内容。 当这三个状态被共同呈现时，一次编辑便成为一项可核查的承诺：系统清楚自己必须建立什么、不得干扰什么，以及哪些证据可被视为任务完成。 计划本身仍然有用，但它已成为契约的一个可修订的实现方案，而非任务本身。

sents.zh: 我们的立场延续了这样一种研究传统：将对象而非过程视为交互的基本单位。

paragraphs.en: We call the runtime that maintains this contract a Task Virtual Machine , and the name is deliberate about scope. It is not an operating-system virtual machine: it owns neither the full state of third-party applications nor the power to roll them back atomically. What it owns is the task’s obligation state and an honest account of evidence. Four commitments make the abstraction tangible. Editing a desired value does not assert that the world changed; desired and observed values sit side by side until fresh observation closes the gap. Marking a record as preserved lifts that constraint out of the agent’s plan and into independent verification. An executor’s completion report does not close a task; a separate verifier checks fresh screen evidence first. And a checkpoint is not time travel; recovery is expressed as the operations the environment actually supports.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将维护此合约的运行时称为任务虚拟机，这一名称的命名是有意为之，以明确其作用范围。它并非操作系统虚拟机：它既不属于第三方应用程序的完整状态，也不具备将其原子性回滚的能力。它所拥有的，是任务的义务状态以及对证据的诚实记录。四项承诺使这种抽象概念变得具体可感。编辑期望值并不意味着世界已经改变；期望值与观测到的值会并列存在，直到新的观测弥合二者之间的差距。将记录标记为已保存，会将这一约束从智能体的计划中移除，并转入独立验证。执行者的完成报告并不会结束一项任务；一个独立的验证者会首先检查新的屏幕证据。而检查点并非时间旅行；恢复过程则通过环境实际支持的操作来表达。

paragraphs.en: We realize this stance in TaskVM , a prototype that places the observed state of live applications beside editable task controls. The runtime compiles user edits into genuine interface gestures, so authority flows through the same rendered interface a human would use. An independent visual verifier , architecturally separated from the executor, checks fresh observations against the contract, and the interface distinguishes reversible, compensatable, and irreversible actions so that recovery is described as supported operations rather than a blanket promise. As the Java Virtual Machine (JVM) exposes one bytecode interface across operating systems, the task virtual machine exposes one obligation model across software stacks; substrate independence is the extent of the analogy we intend.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 TaskVM 中实现了这一立场，它是一个原型系统，将正在运行的应用程序的当前状态与可编辑的任务控制项并列显示。 运行时环境会将用户的编辑操作编译为真实的界面手势，从而使得权限能够通过人类会使用的同一渲染界面进行流转。 一个独立的视觉验证器在架构上与执行器分离，它会将新的观察结果与合同进行比对；同时，该界面能够区分可撤销、可补偿和不可逆的操作，因此恢复机制被描述为受支持的具体操作，而非一项笼统的承诺。 正如 Java 虚拟机（JVM）在不同操作系统上提供统一的字节码接口一样，任务虚拟机也在不同软件栈上提供统一的责任模型；我们意图的类比范围仅限于这种底层独立性。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the paradigm through three complementary lenses, asking three research questions (RQ):
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过三种互补的视角来评估这一范式，并提出三个研究问题（RQ）：

paragraphs.en: RQ1: Does representing tasks as state contracts improve machine-level satisfaction of governance obligations compared with procedural agent baselines, and at what execution cost?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题1：与基于过程的传统智能体基线相比，将任务表示为状态契约能否提升治理义务在机器层面的满足度？其执行成本又是多少？

paragraphs.en: RQ2: When execution outcomes are held constant, does governing state change how well users understand, control, and trust the agent?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题2：在执行结果保持不变的情况下，状态治理是否会影响用户对智能体的理解、控制与信任程度？

paragraphs.en: RQ3: Does the paradigm remain usable and welcome when a live model executes tasks that participants author themselves?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题3：当实时模型执行由参与者自行撰写的任务时，这种范式是否仍然可用且受用户欢迎？

paragraphs.en: An automated benchmark over 36 task instances drawn from a suite of productivity, social, and content applications measured contract satisfaction and its costs. A controlled within-subject study with 37 participants compared TaskVM against a conversational agent interface under replayed execution, isolating perception from execution variance. An exploratory follow-up with 14 returning participants observed live-model use on self-authored tasks. Across these lenses, TaskVM improved contract compliance at higher machine cost, significantly increased perceived recovery control and trust while execution outcomes were held constant, and remained usable in open-ended use, where participants exercised recovery operations and asked for more.
paragraphs.zh: 一项自动化基准测试评估了来自生产力、社交和内容应用套件中的 36 个任务实例，以衡量合同满意度及其成本。 一项包含 37 名参与者的受控被试内研究，在重播执行环境下将 TaskVM 与对话智能体界面进行了比较，从而将感知差异与执行差异分离开来。 一项探索性后续研究邀请了 14 名回归参与者，观察了他们在自主创建任务时如何使用实时模型。 从这些不同视角来看，TaskVM 在机器成本更高时提升了合同合规性，显著增强了感知中的恢复控制感和信任度，同时执行结果保持不变；此外，它在开放式使用场景中也保持了可用性，参与者能够执行恢复操作并提出更多需求。

paragraphs.en: Task-state governance , an interaction model that represents a task as an editable contract over desired outcomes, preservation constraints, and observed state, together with an explicit taxonomy of recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 任务状态治理，一种交互模型，它将任务表示为一份可编辑的契约，涵盖期望结果、保留约束和观测状态，并附带明确的恢复分类体系。

paragraphs.en: TaskVM , a prototype that instantiates the model through live state projection, GUI-grounded bidirectional execution, independent verification, and honestly bounded recovery, running across web, mobile, and desktop substrates.
paragraphs.zh: TaskVM，一个通过实时状态投影、基于图形用户界面的双向执行、独立验证和诚实有界恢复来实例化该模型的原型，可在网页、移动和桌面底层环境中运行。

paragraphs.en: A multi-tier evaluation combining an automated contract benchmark, a controlled user study, and an open live-model exploration, together with design implications for agent interfaces that users can govern rather than merely watch.
paragraphs.zh: 一种多层级评估方法，结合了自动化合同基准测试、受控用户研究以及开放式的实时模型探索，同时提出了智能体界面的设计建议，使用户能够主动管理界面，而不仅仅是被动观察。

paragraphs.en: Our research intersects four traditions: autonomous graphical user interface agents, interfaces that project agent execution, bidirectional and malleable data abstractions, and human-agent governance and awareness. Appendix Table 7 maps this landscape along the object each interface asks the user to govern, tracing what an edit commits each system to, what counts as completion, and what recovery can mean.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究融合了四个传统领域：自主图形用户界面智能体、投射智能体执行过程的界面、双向且可塑的数据抽象，以及人与智能体的治理与感知。 附录中的表 7 沿着每个界面要求用户治理的对象，描绘了这一全景图，并追溯了每次编辑使各个系统承担的责任、何种状态算作完成，以及恢复可能意味着什么。

sents.en: Appendix Table 7 maps this landscape along the object each interface asks the user to govern, tracing what an edit commits each system to, what counts as completion, and what recovery can mean.

paragraphs.en: Autonomous graphical user interface agents have transitioned from scripted web automation to multimodal models operating across web ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Koh et al., 2024 ; Deng et al., 2023 ) , desktop ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) , and mobile operating systems ( Rawles et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) . Modern systems specialize in coordinate-level display grounding ( Cheng et al., 2024 ; Gou et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Qin et al., 2025 ) , supported by structured reasoning loops ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ) . However, benchmark success on autonomous execution does not resolve the human interaction problem. Autonomous traces remain opaque, self-reported completion often diverges from application reality, and single-pass metrics ignore the interactive cost of correcting intermediate errors. Rather than proposing another grounding model, we investigate how agents operate within an architecture that enforces state transparency, non-interference, and verifiable outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 自主图形用户界面智能体已从脚本化网页自动化转向多模态模型，这些模型可在网页（Zhou et al., 2024；Koh et al., 2024；Deng et al., 2023）、桌面系统（Xie et al., 2024；Hu et al., 2025）以及移动操作系统（Rawles et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2024）中运行。 现代系统专注于坐标级的显示定位（Cheng et al., 2024；Gou et al., 2025；Xu et al., 2025；Lin et al., 2025；Qin et al., 2025），并由结构化推理循环提供支持（Yao et al., 2023；Zheng et al., 2024；He et al., 2024）。 然而，在自主执行方面的基准测试成功并未解决人机交互问题。 自主执行的轨迹仍然不透明，自我报告的完成状态往往与应用程序的实际状态不符，而单次通过评估指标则忽略了纠正中间错误所产生的交互成本。 我们并非要提出另一种定位模型，而是研究智能体如何在一种强制要求状态透明、互不干扰且结果可验证的架构中运行。

paragraphs.en: To support human oversight, prior research has explored diverse representations of agent operations. Interactive scaffolding demonstrated the value of structured prompt chains for inspectable sub-steps ( Wu et al., 2022 ) . Plan-centric systems externalize reasoning into sequential steps, decision forks, and progress indicators ( Feng et al., 2026 ; Huq et al., 2025 ; Mozannar et al., 2025 ) . Plover represents the closest point of comparison: it surfaces structured plans that users can locally revise, keeps executed plan steps as immutable history, attaches derived constraints and visual checks to actions, and runs a cross-platform executor across desktop environments ( Venkatesan et al., 2026 ) . Beyond a six-person formative study, its evaluation includes an expert benchmark-repair analysis in which the first author intervened on 26 autonomous failures and improved 23, presented by the authors as an upper bound on recoverability rather than typical user performance.
paragraphs.zh: 为了支持人类监督，先前的研究探索了智能体操作的多种表示形式。 交互式脚手架证明了结构化提示链在实现可检查子步骤方面的价值（Wu 等，2022）。 以规划为中心的系统将推理过程外显化为顺序步骤、决策分支和进度指示器（Feng 等，2026；Huq 等，2025；Mozannar 等，2025）。 Plover 是最接近的对比对象：它能生成结构化规划，供用户进行本地修订；将已执行的规划步骤作为不可篡改的历史记录保留；为动作附加衍生约束和视觉检查；并能在不同桌面环境中运行跨平台执行器（Venkatesan 等，2026）。 除了一项六人参与的初步研究外，其评估还包括一项专家基准修复分析：第一作者在 26 次自主失败中进行了干预并成功修复了 23 次。作者将此结果视为可恢复性的上限，而非典型用户的表现水平。

paragraphs.en: Our comparison concerns the object of interaction and the responsibilities attached to an edit. In plan-centric designs, the protected object is the plan’s executed history, whereas the obligations we study protect facts inside external applications. The evidence of completion also differs in scope: plan-centric systems inspect plan state and screens for execution continuity, whereas our verifier certifies explicit contract obligations (target satisfaction and non-interference over protected facts) from fresh, independently obtained observations of application state. And the evaluative claims attach to different populations: expert-assisted recoverability in a formative setting, versus unaided use by ordinary participants under controlled replay. We read these framings as protecting different assets, and the two objects can compose within one system.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的比较涉及交互对象以及与编辑相关的责任。 在以计划为中心的设计中，受保护的对象是计划的执行历史，而我们所研究的义务则用于保护外部应用程序中的事实。 完成证据的范围也存在差异：以计划为中心的系统会检查计划状态和屏幕以确保执行连续性，而我们的验证器则通过从应用程序状态中独立获取的新观察结果，来确认明确的合同义务（目标满足以及对受保护事实的非干扰性）。 此外，评估主张所针对的群体也不同：一种是在形成性环境中由专家协助实现的恢复能力，另一种则是普通参与者在受控重演条件下无辅助使用的情况。 我们将这些框架解读为对不同资产的保护，并且这两种对象可以在一个系统内共同存在。

paragraphs.en: Complementary work explores malleable views and generative interfaces. Morae pauses browser workflows to preserve critical user choices ( Peng et al., 2025 ) . Sidekick visualizes multi-task status ( Chang et al., 2026 ) , while AgentLens adaptively renders mobile interfaces ( Kim et al., 2026 ) . In web mashups, Orca extracts components with bidirectional DOM synchronization ( Jiang and Xia, 2026 ) , and A-mash combines mobile features into task mashups ( Lee et al., 2022 ) . Generative UI frameworks synthesize on-demand task cards ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Cao et al., 2025 ; Xie and Xie, 2026 ; Kong et al., 2026 ; Vaithilingam et al., 2024 ) . Systems such as DynaVis, which composes widgets on demand ( Vaithilingam et al., 2024 ) , and Orca, which organizes web components across pages ( Jiang and Xia, 2026 ) , anchor their evidence loops inside the browser they render; cross-application compensation and fresh-observation checks of protected state lie outside the problems these systems set out to solve.
paragraphs.zh: 互补性研究探索了可塑视图和生成式接口。 Morae 暂停浏览器工作流程，以保留关键的用户选择（Peng 等人，2025）。 Sidekick 可视化多任务状态（Chang 等人，2026），而 AgentLens 则自适应地渲染移动界面（Kim 等人，2026）。 在网络混合应用中，Orca 通过双向 DOM 同步提取组件（Jiang 和 Xia，2026），而 A-mash 则将移动功能整合到任务混合应用中（Lee 等人，2022）。 生成式 UI 框架可按需合成任务卡片（Xu 等人，2026；Cao 等人，2025；Xie 和 Xie，2026；Kong 等人，2026；Vaithilingam 等人，2024）。 诸如 DynaVis（按需组合小工具，Vaithilingam 等人，2024）和 Orca（跨页面组织网络组件，Jiang 和 Xia，2026）之类的系统，将其证据循环锚定在它们所渲染的浏览器内部；跨应用的补偿以及对受保护状态的观察检查，则超出了这些系统旨在解决的问题范围。

sents.en: Complementary work explores malleable views and generative interfaces.

paragraphs.en: Decoupling physical storage from logical views originates in relational databases ( Codd, 1970 ) and declarative querying ( Chamberlin and Boyce, 1974 ) . Translating edits on projected views back into source structures is formalized as the view-update problem, addressed by Foster et al. through bidirectional lenses with round-trip fidelity ( Foster et al., 2007 ) . In distributed computing, managing multi-step mutations led Garcia-Molina and Salem to formulate Saga transactions with compensating steps ( Garcia-Molina and Salem, 1987 ; Gray, 1981 ; Helland, 2007 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 将物理存储与逻辑视图解耦的构想源于关系数据库（Codd，1970）和声明式查询（Chamberlin 和 Boyce，1974）。 将投影视图上的编辑操作回译到源结构的过程被正式定义为视图更新问题，Foster 等人通过具有往返保真度的双向透镜解决了该问题（Foster 等，2007）。 在分布式计算中，多步骤突变的管理促使 Garcia-Molina 和 Salem 提出了包含补偿步骤的 Saga 事务（Garcia-Molina 和 Salem，1987；Gray，1981；Helland，2007）。

sents.en: Decoupling physical storage from logical views originates in relational databases ( Codd, 1970 ) and declarative querying ( Chamberlin and Boyce, 1974 ) .
sents.zh: 将物理存储与逻辑视图解耦的构想源于关系数据库（Codd，1970）和声明式查询（Chamberlin 和 Boyce，1974）。

sents.en: Translating edits on projected views back into source structures is formalized as the view-update problem, addressed by Foster et al. through bidirectional lenses with round-trip fidelity ( Foster et al., 2007 ) .
sents.zh: 将投影视图上的编辑操作回译到源结构的过程被正式定义为视图更新问题，Foster 等人通过具有往返保真度的双向透镜解决了该问题（Foster 等，2007）。

sents.en: In distributed computing, managing multi-step mutations led Garcia-Molina and Salem to formulate Saga transactions with compensating steps ( Garcia-Molina and Salem, 1987 ; Gray, 1981 ; Helland, 2007 ) .
sents.zh: 在分布式计算中，多步骤突变的管理促使 Garcia-Molina 和 Salem 提出了包含补偿步骤的 Saga 事务（Garcia-Molina 和 Salem，1987；Gray，1981；Helland，2007）。

paragraphs.en: In HCI, declarative generation decouples task specifications from widget layouts, as demonstrated by SUPPLE ( Gajos and Weld, 2004 ) . Recent declarative systems like DMI ( Wang et al., 2026 ) and VeriSafe ( Lee et al., 2025 ) compile state targets and safety constraints into accessibility gestures. Generative UI protocols such as A2UI ( Google A2UI Team, 2026 ) and GenUI ( Leviathan et al., 2026 ) define standards for streaming components, while UICoder ( Wu et al., 2024 ) and Cells ( Kim et al., 2023 ) present methods for interactive UI code generation and structured interfaces. TaskVM adapts these principles to computer-use agents, treating heterogeneous interfaces as a distributed database and compiling user edits into verified, compensatable actions across applications.
paragraphs.zh: 在 HCI 领域，声明式生成将任务规范与控件布局解耦，正如 SUPPLE（Gajos 和 Weld，2004）所演示的那样。 近期的声明式系统，如 DMI（Wang 等，2026）和 VeriSafe（Lee 等，2025），将状态目标和安全约束编译为可访问性手势。 生成式 UI 协议，例如 A2UI（Google A2UI 团队，2026）和 GenUI（Leviathan 等，2026），定义了流式组件的标准，而 UICoder（Wu 等，2024）和 Cells（Kim 等，2023）则提出了交互式 UI 代码生成和结构化界面的方法。 TaskVM 将这些原则应用于计算机使用智能体，将异构接口视为分布式数据库，并将用户编辑编译为跨应用程序经过验证且可补偿的操作。

paragraphs.en: Designing effective oversight requires mitigating automation complacency. Human supervisory performance degrades during passive monitoring ( Bainbridge, 1983 ) , fostering automation bias when agents exhibit high but imperfect competence ( Parasuraman and Riley, 1997 ; Parasuraman and Manzey, 2010 ) . Mixed-initiative frameworks advocate dynamic responsibility allocation ( Horvitz, 1999 ; Maes, 1994 ) . Human-AI guidelines emphasize communicating system actions, supporting efficient error correction, and conveying operational boundaries ( Amershi et al., 2019 ) . Furthermore, mitigating over-reliance requires cognitive forcing functions that prompt deliberate verification ( Lee and See, 2004 ; Hoff and Bashir, 2015 ; Buçinca et al., 2021 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 设计有效的监督机制需要缓解自动化带来的自满情绪。 在被动监控过程中，人类的监督表现会下降（Bainbridge, 1983），而当智能体展现出高但非完美的能力时，这种表现会助长自动化偏见（Parasuraman and Riley, 1997; Parasuraman and Manzey, 2010）。 混合主动框架主张动态分配责任（Horvitz, 1999; Maes, 1994）。 人类与人工智能的协作指南强调传达系统行为、支持高效的错误纠正，并明确操作边界（Amershi et al., 2019）。 此外，要缓解过度依赖，需要引入认知强制机制，以促使用户进行主动验证（Lee and See, 2004; Hoff and Bashir, 2015; Buçinca et al., 2021）。

sents.en: Designing effective oversight requires mitigating automation complacency.

paragraphs.en: Human agency is further supported by malleable, reversible interaction. HCI inquiries show that users continuously appropriate software to fit evolving practices ( Dourish, 2003 ; Dix, 2007 ; Tchounikine, 2017 ) . Reversibility underpins direct manipulation through rapid, reversible operations with visible impact ( Shneiderman, 1983 ; Hutchins et al., 1985 ) , formalized in command trees, selective undo, and side views ( Abowd and Dix, 1992 ; Myers and Kosbie, 1996 ; Terry and Mynatt, 2002 ) . Across multi-device and task-centric computing, systems maintain continuity across fragmented tools ( Rekimoto, 1997 ; Rekimoto and Saitoh, 1999 ; Brudy et al., 2019 ; Henderson and Card, 1986 ; Kaptelinin, 2003 ; Bardram, 2005 ; Lachand et al., 2019 ) . Finally, collaborative awareness requires visible artifacts that expose system capabilities and boundaries ( Dourish and Bellotti, 1992 ; Heath and Luff, 1992 ; Suchman, 1995 ; Bellotti and Edwards, 2001 ; Kulesza et al., 2015 ; Sengers et al., 2005 ) . TaskVM synthesizes these insights by replacing passive trajectory tracking with an editable, live projection of verified application state.
paragraphs.zh: 人类智能体的行动能力还得到了可塑且可逆的交互方式的进一步支持。 人机交互领域的研究表明，用户会持续调整软件以适配不断变化的实践方式（Dourish, 2003；Dix, 2007；Tchounikine, 2017）。 可逆性通过快速、可逆且影响可见的操作为直接操控提供了基础（Shneiderman, 1983；Hutchins et al., 1985），这些操作被形式化为命令树、选择性撤销和侧边视图（Abowd and Dix, 1992；Myers and Kosbie, 1996；Terry and Mynatt, 2002）。 在多设备与任务导向的计算环境中，系统能够在碎片化的工具之间保持连续性（Rekimoto, 1997；Rekimoto and Saitoh, 1999；Brudy et al., 2019；Henderson and Card, 1986；Kaptelinin, 2003；Bardram, 2005；Lachand et al., 2019）。 最后，协作感知需要可见的实体来揭示系统的能力与边界（Dourish and Bellotti, 1992；Heath and Luff, 1992；Suchman, 1995；Bellotti and Edwards, 2001；Kulesza et al., 2015；Sengers et al., 2005）。 TaskVM 通过用可编辑的、实时呈现的已验证应用状态来替代被动的轨迹追踪，综合了上述这些洞见。

paragraphs.en: To bridge human intent and autonomous software execution, we formulate a task-state governance model elevating application state into the primary interactive medium: humans govern tasks, while agents operate applications.
paragraphs.zh: 为了弥合人类意图与自主软件执行之间的鸿沟，我们构建了一种任务状态治理模型，将应用状态提升为主要交互媒介：人类负责管理任务，而智能体则负责操作应用。

paragraphs.en: Current interactive agents structure human intervention around plan intent, presenting upcoming procedural steps, tool invocations, or sub-goal trees ( Feng et al., 2026 ; Venkatesan et al., 2026 ) . When a user intervenes, the operation modifies an upcoming action, such as replacing a query or deleting a click. While offering procedural steerability, this conflates what the agent attempts with what the user requires the world to become: a step can execute without error yet fail to achieve the intended outcome, or inadvertently corrupt adjacent records ( Bainbridge, 1983 ; Amershi et al., 2019 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 当前的交互式智能体将人类干预围绕计划意图进行组织，展示即将执行的过程步骤、工具调用或子目标树（Feng 等，2026；Venkatesan 等，2026）。 当用户进行干预时，该操作会修改一个即将执行的动作，例如替换某个查询或删除一次点击。 尽管这种方法提供了过程上的可控性，但它却将智能体的尝试与用户希望世界发生的变化混为一谈：一个步骤可能无误执行，却未能达成预期结果，甚至可能意外损坏相邻记录（Bainbridge，1983；Amershi 等，2019）。

paragraphs.en: In contrast, our interaction model formalizes user intent as state intent, specifying invariant properties that must hold true once execution concludes. Instead of dictating navigation paths, the user specifies what application facts must change and what historical context must remain undisturbed. As defined in our domain schema, an ActionContract encapsulates these state obligations independently of platform execution paths. This distinction decouples human governance from low-level software idiosyncrasies: just as programming runtimes allow developers to declare invariants while delegating memory management, our model enables users to express task invariants while delegating mouse coordinates and Document Object Model (DOM) traversals to autonomous executors. As mapped across the top band of Figure 3 , a governed round trip traverses eight semantic stages from Observe and Abstract through Reconcile to close a single episode.
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，我们的交互模型将用户意图形式化为状态意图，明确了执行结束后必须成立的不变属性。 用户无需指定导航路径，只需说明哪些应用事实必须改变，以及哪些历史上下文必须保持原样。 正如我们在领域模式中定义的那样，ActionContract 独立于平台的执行路径，将这些状态义务封装起来。 这种区分将人类治理与低层软件的特定特性解耦：正如编程运行时允许开发者声明不变量同时委托内存管理一样，我们的模型也使用户能够表达任务不变量，同时将鼠标坐标和文档对象模型（DOM）的遍历操作委托给自主执行者。 如图 3 的上部区域所示，一次受控的往返流程会经过八个语义阶段，从“观察与抽象”开始，历经“协调”，最终完成一个独立的事件周期。

paragraphs.en: To make state intent manipulable without exposing raw complexity, our model compiles live software state into an executable view, compressing distributed fields into a unified, low-cognitive-load surface. Figure 2 shows the governance interface that realizes this view, organized into three zones that mirror the state representations of our model.
paragraphs.zh: 为了让状态意图可以被操控，同时不暴露原始复杂性，我们的模型将实时软件状态编译为可执行视图，将分布式字段压缩成一个统一且认知负荷较低的表面。 图 2 展示了实现该视图的治理界面，其布局分为三个区域，分别对应我们模型中的状态表示。

sents.en: To make state intent manipulable without exposing raw complexity, our model compiles live software state into an executable view, compressing distributed fields into a unified, low-cognitive-load surface.

sents.en: Figure 2 shows the governance interface that realizes this view, organized into three zones that mirror the state representations of our model.
sents.zh: 图 2 展示了实现该视图的治理界面，其布局分为三个区域，分别对应我们模型中的状态表示。

paragraphs.en: Zone C (Editable Task State and Live World) presents the desired, preserve, and observed fields of each task variable side by side with the live application window. The observed column is a read-only faithful projection of current software reality, grounded in visual evidence parsed directly from rendered screens ( Suchman, 1995 ) ; the desired column is editable, and the preserve column pins facts that must remain undisturbed. Zone A (Task Intent and Global Governance) hosts the mission contract and lifecycle controls, and Zone B (Execution Progress and Local Governance) exposes execution progress, the live status of each model-invoking role, and the model call chain.
paragraphs.zh: C区（可编辑任务状态与实时世界）将每个任务变量的期望、保留和观察字段与实时应用程序窗口并列展示。 观察列是对当前软件现实的只读忠实投影，其依据是直接解析自渲染屏幕的视觉证据（Suchman, 1995）；期望列支持编辑，而保留列则锁定必须保持不变的要素。 A区（任务意图与全局治理）承载任务契约和生命周期控制，而B区（执行进度与局部治理）则显示执行进度、每个模型调用角色的实时状态以及模型调用链。

paragraphs.en: Maintaining fidelity between the projection and external software requires continuous bidirectional synchronization. The projection streams dynamic live deltas through server-sent events, updating the interface as the external world changes. When concurrent external modifications occur, such as a colleague editing a shared document, the system triggers reconciliation mechanisms. Rather than silently overwriting external modifications or crashing the pipeline, TaskVM surfaces external changes as explicit conflict markers in Zone C , inviting the user to reconcile divergent values through deliberate interaction ( Dourish and Bellotti, 1992 ; Buçinca et al., 2021 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 要保持投影与外部软件之间的一致性，就需要持续进行双向同步。 投影通过服务器发送事件流传输动态实时增量数据，随着外部世界的变化更新界面。 当发生并发的外部修改时（例如同事编辑共享文档），系统会触发协调机制。 TaskVM 不会静默覆盖外部修改或导致流程崩溃，而是将外部变化作为显式的冲突标记显示在区域 C 中，邀请用户通过主动互动来协调不一致的值（Dourish and Bellotti, 1992; Buçinca et al., 2021）。

sents.en: Maintaining fidelity between the projection and external software requires continuous bidirectional synchronization.
sents.zh: 要保持投影与外部软件之间的一致性，就需要持续进行双向同步。

sents.zh: 投影通过服务器发送事件流传输动态实时增量数据，随着外部世界的变化更新界面。

sents.en: Rather than silently overwriting external modifications or crashing the pipeline, TaskVM surfaces external changes as explicit conflict markers in Zone C , inviting the user to reconcile divergent values through deliberate interaction ( Dourish and Bellotti, 1992 ; Buçinca et al., 2021 ) .

paragraphs.en: We formalize task-state governance through three interconnected state representations:
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过三种相互关联的状态表示来形式化任务状态治理：

paragraphs.en: The desired state S desired S_{\text{desired}} consists of target variables { v 1 ↦ c 1 , … , v n ↦ c n } \{v_{1}\mapsto c_{1},\dots,v_{n}\mapsto c_{n}\} that the user authorizes the agent to establish. The preservation scope S preserve S_{\text{preserve}} defines invariant constraints over protected application entities. In real-world workflows, accomplishing a goal often threatens adjacent data; for example, updating a meeting time must not alter room reservations or attendee notes. By formalizing S preserve S_{\text{preserve}} as an explicit mathematical construct, our model establishes verifiable non-interference boundaries: any execution establishing S desired S_{\text{desired}} while violating an invariant in S preserve S_{\text{preserve}} is classified as an operational failure. The observed state S observed S_{\text{observed}} captures visual facts parsed from rendered application screens at time t t . A task transition is formally valid if and only if fresh visual observation confirms that external software satisfies the desired state while leaving the preservation scope inviolate:
paragraphs.zh: 期望状态 S_{\text{desired}} 由目标变量集合 \{v_{1}\mapsto c_{1},\dots,v_{n}\mapsto c_{n}\} 构成，用户授权智能体建立该状态。 保留范围 S_{\text{preserve}} 定义了受保护应用程序实体上的不变量约束。 在现实世界的工作流程中，实现目标往往会威胁到相邻数据；例如，更新会议时间不得更改房间预订或与会者笔记。 通过将 S_{\text{preserve}} 形式化为一个显式的数学结构，我们的模型建立了可验证的非干扰边界：任何在建立 S_{\text{desired}} 的同时违反 S_{\text{preserve}} 中不变量的执行操作，均被归类为运行失败。 观测状态 S_{\text{observed}} 捕捉了时间 t 时从渲染后的应用程序屏幕解析出的视觉事实。 一个任务转换当且仅当新的视觉观测确认外部软件满足期望状态，同时保持保留范围不受侵犯时，才是形式上有效的：

sents.zh: 期望状态 S_{\text{desired}} 由目标变量集合 \{v_{1}\mapsto c_{1},\dots,v_{n}\mapsto c_{n}\} 构成，用户授权智能体建立该状态。

sents.en: A task transition is formally valid if and only if fresh visual observation confirms that external software satisfies the desired state while leaving the preservation scope inviolate:
sents.zh: 一个任务转换当且仅当新的视觉观测确认外部软件满足期望状态，同时保持保留范围不受侵犯时，才是形式上有效的：

paragraphs.en: The user governs the relationship between S desired S_{\text{desired}} and S preserve S_{\text{preserve}} in the governance console (Zone C of Figure 2 ), while the runtime engine continuously reconciles S observed S_{\text{observed}} against external software.
paragraphs.zh: 用户在治理控制台中（图 2 的 C 区）管理期望状态 S_{\text{desired}} 与保留状态 S_{\text{preserve}} 之间的关系，而运行时引擎则持续将观测到的状态 S_{\text{observed}} 与外部软件进行协调。

paragraphs.en: A core tenet of our governance model is that execution completion must never be self-certified by the executing agent. Autonomous agents frequently report success prematurely, mistaking the emission of a completion token for actual state alteration ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ) . Our model delegates verification to an independent visual verifier evaluating rendered application screens.
paragraphs.zh: 我们治理模型的核心原则之一是：执行过程绝不允许由执行智能体自行确认完成。 自主智能体经常过早报告成功，误将完成标记的生成视为实际状态的改变（Zheng 等，2024；He 等，2024）。 我们的模型将验证工作委托给一个独立的视觉验证器，由其评估渲染出的应用程序界面。

sents.en: A core tenet of our governance model is that execution completion must never be self-certified by the executing agent.
sents.zh: 我们治理模型的核心原则之一是：执行过程绝不允许由执行智能体自行确认完成。

sents.en: Autonomous agents frequently report success prematurely, mistaking the emission of a completion token for actual state alteration ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 自主智能体经常过早报告成功，误将完成标记的生成视为实际状态的改变（Zheng 等，2024；He 等，2024）。

sents.en: Our model delegates verification to an independent visual verifier evaluating rendered application screens.
sents.zh: 我们的模型将验证工作委托给一个独立的视觉验证器，由其评估渲染出的应用程序界面。

paragraphs.en: The verification engine enforces two complementary properties: target satisfaction and non-interference. To verify target satisfaction, the verifier requires visible witness predicates, demanding explicit evidence that an intended modification was actively enacted to eliminate the no-op loophole where an agent claims success on a pre-existing state. To enforce non-interference, the verifier evaluates negative predicates over specified, observable entities in S preserve S_{\text{preserve}} , confirming that protected fields display the same values in fresh screenshots. Crucially, the independent verifier operates with strict contextual and architectural isolation from the executing agent, sharing no internal reasoning buffers or prompt scaffolding; in the interface it appears as a first-class role awaiting fresh observation (Zone B of Figure 2 ). Evaluating fresh visual observations against formal predicates provides an objective, falsifiable gate before any task is marked complete in the user interface ( Bellotti and Edwards, 2001 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 验证引擎强制执行两种互补的特性：目标满足性和非干扰性。 为了验证目标满足性，验证器需要可见的见证谓词，要求提供明确证据，证明预期的修改已被主动执行，从而消除“无操作漏洞”——即智能体声称对已有状态成功操作的情况。 为了强制执行非干扰性，验证器会对 S 中指定的可观察实体上的否定谓词进行评估，以确认受保护字段在新生成的截图中显示相同的值（S preserve S_{\text{preserve}}）。 关键在于，独立的验证器在执行智能体之外严格保持上下文和架构隔离，不共享任何内部推理缓冲区或提示框架；在界面中，它表现为一个等待新观察结果的一等角色（图 2 的 B 区）。 将新的视觉观察结果与形式化谓词进行比对，可在任何任务在用户界面中被标记为完成之前，提供一个客观且可证伪的验证关口（Bellotti and Edwards, 2001）。

paragraphs.en: Real-world software interactions require robust mechanisms for error correction, interruption, and recovery. In traditional direct manipulation interfaces, undo operations revert local memory structures ( Shneiderman, 1983 ; Abowd and Dix, 1992 ) . However, in multi-application environments, software changes induce persistent external side effects that cannot be undone by simple state restoration ( Gray, 1981 ; Garcia-Molina and Salem, 1987 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 现实世界中的软件交互需要强大的机制来实现错误纠正、中断和恢复。 在传统直接操控界面中，撤销操作会还原局部内存结构（Shneiderman, 1983；Abowd and Dix, 1992）。 然而，在多应用程序环境中，软件变更会引发持续的外部副作用，这些副作用无法通过简单的状态恢复来撤销（Gray, 1981；Garcia-Molina and Salem, 1987）。

sents.en: Real-world software interactions require robust mechanisms for error correction, interruption, and recovery.
sents.zh: 现实世界中的软件交互需要强大的机制来实现错误纠正、中断和恢复。

sents.en: In traditional direct manipulation interfaces, undo operations revert local memory structures ( Shneiderman, 1983 ; Abowd and Dix, 1992 ) .
sents.zh: 在传统直接操控界面中，撤销操作会还原局部内存结构（Shneiderman, 1983；Abowd and Dix, 1992）。

sents.en: However, in multi-application environments, software changes induce persistent external side effects that cannot be undone by simple state restoration ( Gray, 1981 ; Garcia-Molina and Salem, 1987 ) .
sents.zh: 然而，在多应用程序环境中，软件变更会引发持续的外部副作用，这些副作用无法通过简单的状态恢复来撤销（Gray, 1981；Garcia-Molina and Salem, 1987）。

paragraphs.en: Our model establishes a taxonomy of operational reversibility, codified in our implementation as Reversibility :
paragraphs.zh: 我们的模型建立了一套操作可逆性的分类体系，并在我们的实现中将其编码为 Reversibility：

paragraphs.en: Reversible Actions: Operations whose effects can be completely and symmetrically undone through standard graphical gestures without residual impact, such as toggling an unsubmitted checkbox or clearing a draft text field.
paragraphs.zh: 可逆操作：其效果可通过标准图形手势完全且对称地撤销，且不会留下任何残留影响的操作，例如切换未提交的复选框或清空草稿文本字段。

paragraphs.en: Compensatable Actions: Operations that induce persistent external effects but can be semantically counterbalanced through secondary compensation actions, such as sending a cancellation message to follow an erroneous notification ( Garcia-Molina and Salem, 1987 ; Helland, 2007 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 可补偿操作：指那些会产生持久外部影响，但可以通过次要补偿操作在语义上予以抵消的操作，例如发送取消消息以应对错误的通知（Garcia-Molina 和 Salem，1987；Helland，2007）。

paragraphs.en: Irreversible Actions: Operations that permanently modify external systems or invoke physical effects that cannot be restored, such as deleting account archives or completing financial settlements.
paragraphs.zh: 不可逆操作：永久修改外部系统或引发无法恢复的物理效应的操作，例如删除账户存档或完成财务结算。

paragraphs.en: When a user initiates a rollback or edits a historical checkpoint, TaskVM derives a compensation plan exclusively from its committed action history (CompensationPatch). Reversible and compensatable actions execute compensating GUI gestures across affected applications. Conversely, when an action crosses an irreversible boundary, the interaction model prohibits deceptive representations of undo: the global rollback dialog in Zone A (Figure 2 ) previews which committed steps would be replayed or restored, explicitly marks effects that are not auto-compensable, and locks irreversible entities with transparent status badges, preventing the dangerous illusion of complete reversibility and supporting appropriate reliance ( Lee and See, 2004 ; Buçinca et al., 2021 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 当用户发起回滚或编辑历史检查点时，TaskVM 仅基于其已提交的行动历史（CompensationPatch）推导出补偿方案。 可逆且可补偿的行动会在受影响的各个应用程序中执行补偿性的 GUI 手势。 相反，当某项行动跨越不可逆边界时，交互模型会禁止对撤销操作进行误导性呈现：区域 A 中的全局回滚对话框（图 2）会预览哪些已提交的步骤将被重播或恢复，明确标记无法自动补偿的影响，并用透明的状态徽章锁定不可逆实体，从而避免产生完全可逆的虚假印象，并支持适当的依赖（Lee and See, 2004；Buçinca et al., 2021）。

paragraphs.en: We implement the task-state governance model in TaskVM, an interactive system governing multi-application workflows across web, mobile, and desktop software. This section details the data flow, privacy boundaries, bidirectional bindings, governance primitives, and substrate abstractions that realize our conceptual framework.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 TaskVM 中实现了任务状态治理模型，这是一个交互式系统，用于管理网页、移动和桌面软件之间的多应用工作流程。 本节详细阐述了数据流、隐私边界、双向绑定、治理原语以及底层抽象，这些元素共同实现了我们的概念框架。

sents.en: We implement the task-state governance model in TaskVM, an interactive system governing multi-application workflows across web, mobile, and desktop software.
sents.zh: 我们在 TaskVM 中实现了任务状态治理模型，这是一个交互式系统，用于管理网页、移动和桌面软件之间的多应用工作流程。

sents.en: This section details the data flow, privacy boundaries, bidirectional bindings, governance primitives, and substrate abstractions that realize our conceptual framework.
sents.zh: 本节详细阐述了数据流、隐私边界、双向绑定、治理原语以及底层抽象，这些元素共同实现了我们的概念框架。

paragraphs.en: As mapped in Figure 3 , TaskVM is organized around a hub-and-spoke data flow centered on the Task-state VM (Kernel). The Kernel serves as the sole owner of task state, maintaining TaskState (intent, variables), workflow graphs, append-only event logs, and epoch checkpoints. By enforcing a defensive read path, the system prevents low-level drivers or downstream consumers from polluting central task semantics.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 3 所示，TaskVM 围绕以 Task-state VM（Kernel）为中心的枢纽-辐条式数据流进行组织。 Kernel 是任务状态的唯一所有者，负责维护 TaskState（意图、变量）、工作流图、仅追加的事件日志以及周期检查点。 通过强制执行防御性读取路径，该系统可防止底层驱动程序或下游消费者污染核心的任务语义。

sents.en: As mapped in Figure 3 , TaskVM is organized around a hub-and-spoke data flow centered on the Task-state VM (Kernel).
sents.zh: 如图 3 所示，TaskVM 围绕以 Task-state VM（Kernel）为中心的枢纽-辐条式数据流进行组织。

sents.en: The Kernel serves as the sole owner of task state, maintaining TaskState (intent, variables), workflow graphs, append-only event logs, and epoch checkpoints.
sents.zh: Kernel 是任务状态的唯一所有者，负责维护 TaskState（意图、变量）、工作流图、仅追加的事件日志以及周期检查点。

sents.en: By enforcing a defensive read path, the system prevents low-level drivers or downstream consumers from polluting central task semantics.
sents.zh: 通过强制执行防御性读取路径，该系统可防止底层驱动程序或下游消费者污染核心的任务语义。

paragraphs.en: Rather than relying on a single vision-language model, TaskVM distributes responsibilities across specialized roles that exchange typed objects with the Kernel. The GUI Agent functions as an Encoder, observing live software displays via dedicated observation structures and channeling them into the State Compiler (F2). The Compiler converts visual candidates into standardized task variables (F2, F2’) and forwards them to the Task Architect. A separate generative interface model functions as a Decoder (F3), translating intent into interactive A2UI components projected to the user interface (F3’). These roles execute through independent model invocations marked by amber indicators, preventing their conversational histories from being shared directly. All experiments reported in this paper instantiate every model-invoking role with the same production model, OpenAI’s GPT-5.6-sol (per-condition configuration in Section 5 and Appendix L ). While this separation limits direct context leakage, it does not eliminate extraction errors or correlated failures, so the generated representation is not treated as evidence of its own correctness.
paragraphs.zh: TaskVM 不依赖单一的视觉-语言模型，而是将职责分配给多个专业角色，这些角色通过类型化的对象与内核进行交互。 GUI 智能体充当编码器，通过专用观察结构实时观测软件界面，并将观察结果传递至状态编译器（F2）。 编译器将视觉候选项转换为标准化的任务变量（F2、F2’），并将其转发给任务架构师。 一个独立的生成式接口模型充当解码器（F3），将意图转化为交互式 A2UI 组件，并投射到用户界面（F3’）。 这些角色通过独立的模型调用执行，并由琥珀色指示符标记，从而避免其对话历史被直接共享。 本论文报告的所有实验均使用相同的生产模型——OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6-sol（第 5 节和附录 L 中的条件配置）来实例化每个模型调用角色。 尽管这种分离限制了直接的上下文泄露，但并未消除提取错误或相关故障，因此生成的表示不会被视为其自身正确性的证据。

paragraphs.en: A pervasive vulnerability in automated GUI systems is reliance on internal implementation identifiers, such as private DOM IDs, database keys, or synthetic accessibility tags. While internal identifiers facilitate automated testing, they break down in open-world environments where dynamic layouts alter internal structures without changing visual appearances. Furthermore, relying on internal identifiers creates backdoors that bypass rendered interfaces, giving automated agents privileges unavailable to human operators.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化 GUI 系统中的一个普遍性漏洞是依赖内部实现标识符，例如私有 DOM ID、数据库键或合成无障碍标签。 虽然内部标识符有助于自动化测试，但在开放世界环境中，动态布局会改变内部结构而不会影响视觉外观，导致这些标识符失效。 此外，依赖内部标识符会创建出绕过渲染界面的后门，使自动化智能体获得人类操作员无法拥有的权限。

sents.en: A pervasive vulnerability in automated GUI systems is reliance on internal implementation identifiers, such as private DOM IDs, database keys, or synthetic accessibility tags.
sents.zh: 自动化 GUI 系统中的一个普遍性漏洞是依赖内部实现标识符，例如私有 DOM ID、数据库键或合成无障碍标签。

paragraphs.en: To maintain operational integrity, TaskVM enforces the GUI-only purity standard. Every piece of data entering the model pipeline must satisfy the one-question test: could a real human user see this exact string on the rendered screen? If an attribute cannot be visually perceived by a human looking at the monitor, it is strictly prohibited from entering any model prompt. The compilation pipeline incorporates an explicit verification module that intercepts candidate records and strips internal database keys, accessibility labels, operator jargon, and deep-link URLs via dedicated hidden-ID scrubbers and architectural no-leak filters. Every task variable in the governance console must link directly to verbatim visual evidence parsed from the display. Moreover, all write operations must traverse authentic graphical gestures (GuiAction), including coordinate-targeted mouse clicks, keystrokes, and scroll events. Any state alteration that does not require a rendered display and simulated user input is classified as an unauthorized backdoor and rejected by the runtime kernel.
paragraphs.zh: 为保持运行完整性，TaskVM 强制执行“仅使用图形用户界面”的纯净标准。 进入模型流程的每一条数据都必须通过“单问题测试”：一个真实的人类用户是否能在渲染后的屏幕上看到这一精确的字符串？ 如果某个属性无法被人类通过观察显示器而直接感知，则严禁其进入任何模型提示词中。 编译流程包含一个显式验证模块，该模块会拦截候选记录，并通过专门的隐藏 ID 清理程序和架构防泄漏过滤器，移除内部数据库键、可访问性标签、操作术语和深度链接 URL。 治理控制台中的每个任务变量都必须直接关联从显示内容中解析出的原始视觉证据。 此外，所有写入操作都必须经过真实的图形化交互动作（GuiAction），包括坐标定位的鼠标点击、键盘输入和滚动事件。 任何无需渲染显示或模拟用户输入的状态变更，均被归类为未经授权的“后门”，并将被运行时内核拒绝。

paragraphs.en: TaskVM achieves bidirectional interaction through executable semantic bindings that connect high-level virtual machine variables to low-level application gestures. We conceptualize this mechanism as an analog to the Java Virtual Machine. Just as a Java programmer modifies an abstract object variable and relies on the virtual machine to translate the assignment into platform-specific memory offsets, a TaskVM user edits an abstract task variable in the governance console and relies on TaskVM to synthesize coordinated writes across heterogeneous software.
paragraphs.zh: TaskVM 通过可执行的语义绑定实现双向交互，这些绑定将高层虚拟机变量与低层应用程序手势连接起来。 我们将这一机制类比为 Java 虚拟机。 正如 Java 程序员修改一个抽象对象变量并依赖虚拟机将该赋值转换为平台特定的内存偏移量一样，TaskVM 用户会在治理控制台中编辑一个抽象任务变量，并依赖 TaskVM 合成跨异构软件的协同写入操作。

sents.en: TaskVM achieves bidirectional interaction through executable semantic bindings that connect high-level virtual machine variables to low-level application gestures.
sents.zh: TaskVM 通过可执行的语义绑定实现双向交互，这些绑定将高层虚拟机变量与低层应用程序手势连接起来。

sents.en: We conceptualize this mechanism as an analog to the Java Virtual Machine.
sents.zh: 我们将这一机制类比为 Java 虚拟机。

sents.zh: 正如 Java 程序员修改一个抽象对象变量并依赖虚拟机将该赋值转换为平台特定的内存偏移量一样，TaskVM 用户会在治理控制台中编辑一个抽象任务变量，并依赖 TaskVM 合成跨异构软件的协同写入操作。

paragraphs.en: When a user alters a variable in the governance console, the system instantiates a semantic ActionContract in our domain schema. The contract specifies what condition must become true in the target application, rather than hardcoding how the application must be navigated. Target entities are identified through robust visual anchors, such as surrounding label text, relative geometric offsets, and icon visual embeddings, rather than brittle pixel coordinates. When a single conceptual edit requires modifications across multiple applications, such as synchronizing a deadline across a project management board and a team chat client, the runtime orchestrates a fan-out execution plan. The execution engine sequences operations across application windows, monitors UI transitions, and commits state updates only after verifying structured action outcomes (ActionReceipt).
paragraphs.zh: 当用户在治理控制台中更改一个变量时，系统会在我们的域模式实例化一个语义 ActionContract。 该合约规定了目标应用程序中必须满足的条件，而不是硬编码应用程序必须如何导航。 目标实体通过稳健的视觉锚点来识别，例如周围的标签文本、相对几何偏移和图标视觉嵌入，而不是脆弱的像素坐标。 当单个概念性编辑需要在多个应用程序中进行修改时（例如，在项目管理板和团队聊天客户端之间同步截止日期），运行时环境会组织一个扇出执行计划。 执行引擎会在不同应用程序窗口中按顺序操作，监控 UI 转换，并在验证结构化操作结果（ActionReceipt）之后才提交状态更新。

paragraphs.en: Real-world human governance requires the ability to intervene while execution is actively underway. TaskVM provides four foundational hot governance primitives: pause, local patch, goal patch, and rollback. At any point during autonomous execution, the user can trigger a pause control in the governance console. The Governance Service immediately issues a halt signal to the active runtime, freezing the execution harness at the current step boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 现实世界中的人类治理需要能够在执行过程正在进行时进行干预的能力。 TaskVM 提供了四种基础的热治理原语：暂停、局部修补、目标修补和回滚。 在自主执行的任何阶段，用户都可以在治理控制台中触发暂停控制。 治理服务会立即向正在运行的运行时发出停止信号，将执行框架冻结在当前步骤的边界处。

sents.en: Real-world human governance requires the ability to intervene while execution is actively underway.
sents.zh: 现实世界中的人类治理需要能够在执行过程正在进行时进行干预的能力。

sents.zh: TaskVM 提供了四种基础的热治理原语：暂停、局部修补、目标修补和回滚。

sents.en: At any point during autonomous execution, the user can trigger a pause control in the governance console.
sents.zh: 在自主执行的任何阶段，用户都可以在治理控制台中触发暂停控制。

sents.en: The Governance Service immediately issues a halt signal to the active runtime, freezing the execution harness at the current step boundary.
sents.zh: 治理服务会立即向正在运行的运行时发出停止信号，将执行框架冻结在当前步骤的边界处。

paragraphs.en: To manage race conditions during mid-execution interventions, TaskVM introduces epoch-based governance gating in the kernel. Every task execution belongs to a monotonically increasing integer epoch. When a user pauses the system and applies a local patch or revises the overarching goal, the governance engine increments the epoch counter. If the autonomous agent was in the process of generating an action from the preceding epoch, the kernel gate intercepts the returning proposal and discards it before dispatch. This prevents stale proposals from being newly dispatched after a revision, without claiming to reverse effects of actions already dispatched.
paragraphs.zh: 为了管理执行中断期间出现的竞争条件，TaskVM 在内核中引入了基于时间片的治理门控机制。 每次任务执行都属于一个单调递增的整数时间片。 当用户暂停系统并应用本地补丁或修改总体目标时，治理引擎会递增时间片计数器。 如果自主智能体正在处理前一时间片中生成的动作，内核门控会拦截返回的提案，并在其被调度前将其丢弃。 这可以防止修订后旧有提案被重新调度，同时不会声称撤销已调度动作所产生的影响。

paragraphs.en: When a user modifies a goal, the system retains valid, committed action history and recomposes only the affected future trajectory, avoiding redundant re-execution of unaffected milestones. When a rollback is requested, the compensation engine analyzes the committed action registry. For reversible operations, the runtime synthesizes inverse graphical gestures, such as untoggling checkboxes or clearing input forms. For compensatable operations, the runtime executes compensating GUI actions, such as dispatching cancellation notes; these counteract the intended effect but do not assure atomic rollback ( Garcia-Molina and Salem, 1987 ) . Finally, when an operation crosses an irreversible threshold, such as a finalized monetary payment, the system prevents misleading undo representations by raising an explicit irreversible signal. Irreversible entities are locked in the interface with transparent explanatory badges, clarifying the limits of automated recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 当用户修改目标时，系统会保留有效且已提交的行动历史，仅重新构建受影响的未来轨迹，从而避免对未受影响的关键节点进行冗余的重复执行。 当请求回滚时，补偿引擎会分析已提交的行动记录。 对于可逆操作，运行时环境会合成反向图形手势，例如取消勾选复选框或清空输入表单。 对于可补偿操作，运行时环境会执行补偿性的 GUI 动作，例如发送取消通知；这些动作能够抵消预期效果，但无法保证原子级回滚（Garcia-Molina 和 Salem，1987）。 最后，当某个操作跨越不可逆阈值时（例如最终完成的货币支付），系统会通过发出明确的不可逆信号，防止出现具有误导性的撤销表示。 不可逆实体会在界面中被锁定，并带有透明的解释性标识，以明确自动化恢复的局限性。

paragraphs.en: A central objective of TaskVM is substrate independence: ensuring that the same high-level task semantics can be governed identically regardless of the underlying operating system or application technology stack. TaskVM abstracts external software through a clean SubstratePort interface, implemented across modular sessions. The SubstratePort defines primitive operations for capturing visual screenshots, reading device metadata, and dispatching standardized mouse and keyboard input events. Our prototype provides implementations for three distinct platforms: modern web applications, the OSWorld Linux desktop benchmark environment ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , and the browser-hosted mobile simulation environment MobileGym ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . Independent visual verification takes place over extracted visual artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: TaskVM 的核心目标之一是底层平台无关性：确保无论底层的操作系统或应用程序技术栈如何，相同的高层任务语义都能得到一致的管理。TaskVM 通过一个简洁的 SubstratePort 接口对外部软件进行抽象，该接口通过模块化会话实现。SubstratePort 定义了捕获视觉截图、读取设备元数据以及分发标准化鼠标和键盘输入事件的基础操作。我们的原型为三种不同的平台提供了实现：现代网络应用程序、OSWorld Linux 桌面基准环境（Xie et al., 2024），以及基于浏览器的移动模拟环境 MobileGym（Wu et al., 2026）。独立的视觉验证则针对提取出的视觉产物进行。

paragraphs.en: To isolate the agent from hidden laboratory shortcuts, TaskVM enforces strict privilege separation between the runtime session and the evaluation harness. The user-facing runtime interacts exclusively with a session object possessing only standard human capabilities: capturing visual display pixels and issuing realistic graphical gestures. Privileged capabilities required by benchmarking, such as resetting databases, reading internal state trees, or injecting deterministic world events, are encapsulated in an isolated evaluation harness. These privileged methods are strictly inaccessible to both the planning agent and the interface compiler. By separating runtime execution from benchmarking machinery, TaskVM ensures that its evaluation results reflect genuine interactive competence.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将智能体与实验室中隐藏的快捷方式隔离开来，TaskVM 在运行时会话与评估框架之间强制执行严格的权限分离。 面向用户的运行时仅与一个会话对象进行交互，该对象只具备标准的人类能力：捕捉视觉显示像素并执行逼真的图形手势。 基准测试所需的特权能力（例如重置数据库、读取内部状态树或注入确定性的世界事件）被封装在一个孤立的评估框架中。 这些特权方法对于规划智能体和接口编译器来说都是严格不可访问的。 通过将运行时执行与基准测试机制分离，TaskVM 确保其评估结果能够反映真实的交互能力。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the technical capabilities, operational bounds, and governance properties of TaskVM through an automated benchmark on a frozen suite of multi-application workflows. This evaluation establishes whether explicit state contracts improve execution reliability over procedural computer-use agents, how performance distributes across task zones, and whether skills injection preserves execution non-inferiority.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过一项针对固定多应用工作流套件的自动化基准测试，评估 TaskVM 的技术能力、运行边界和治理特性。 这项评估旨在确定：显式状态契约相较于程序化的计算机使用智能体能否提升执行可靠性、性能在不同任务区域间的分布情况，以及技能注入能否保持执行的非劣性。

sents.en: We evaluate the technical capabilities, operational bounds, and governance properties of TaskVM through an automated benchmark on a frozen suite of multi-application workflows.

sents.en: This evaluation establishes whether explicit state contracts improve execution reliability over procedural computer-use agents, how performance distributes across task zones, and whether skills injection preserves execution non-inferiority.

paragraphs.en: † Template Control is an assembly sanity-check driver that replays scripted gestures with zero LLM invocations (the 144 figure above counts scripted action events, not model calls); 101 of its 108 runs across the evaluated waves failed at the architect stub due to an implementation limitation in parsing Chinese natural-language goals, so it is not a valid baseline.
paragraphs.zh: † 模板控制（Template Control）是一种用于验证程序集完整性的驱动程序，它通过重播脚本化手势运行，且完全不涉及任何 LLM 调用（上述 144 这一数字统计的是脚本化动作事件，而非模型调用）；在评估的各个阶段中，其 108 次运行中有 101 次因解析中文自然语言目标时存在实现限制而失败于架构占位符，因此它并非一个有效的基准。

paragraphs.en: The automated evaluation suite comprises 36 task instances spanning 12 structural task families derived from the TaskVM architectural contract, with three variants per family. Execution correctness is adjudicated through Contract-Outcome Verification (COV) , structured across ten machine-verifiable domain predicates defined in Appendix A . Each trial is evaluated against all applicable predicates. These include certifying that target fields reach their required final values ( required_final_state ), confirming that protected fields outside the authorized set remain untouched ( protected_non_interference ), ensuring that executions visit required witness checkpoints ( required_witness_trajectory ), and verifying that superseded user intents leave no residual effects ( superseded_intent_suppressed ). Furthermore, transactional boundaries are checked by verifying that pause and stop commands halt execution immediately ( pause_stop_boundary ), externally owned objects are not overwritten ( external_ownership_preservation ), and requested rollbacks restore pre-states without hidden evaluator resets ( no_hidden_evaluator_restore ). We report two complementary metrics: strict pass rate , requiring all applicable predicates in a trial to pass, and atomic predicate mean , measuring the average pass rate across applicable predicates.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化评估套件包含 36 个任务实例，涵盖源自 TaskVM 架构合同的 12 个结构任务族，每个任务族有 3 种变体。 执行正确性通过合同-结果验证（COV）进行判定，该验证基于附录 A 中定义的十个机器可验证的领域谓词。 每次试验均依据所有适用的谓词进行评估。 这些谓词包括：确认目标字段达到其所需的最终值（required_final_state），确认授权集合之外的受保护字段未被篡改（protected_non_interference），确保执行过程访问了必需的见证检查点（required_witness_trajectory），以及验证被取代的用户意图未留下任何残留影响（superseded_intent_suppressed）。 此外，通过验证暂停和停止命令能否立即终止执行（pause_stop_boundary）、外部所有对象是否未被覆盖（external_ownership_preservation），以及请求的回滚能否恢复先前状态且无隐藏评估器重置（no_hidden_evaluator_restore），来检查事务边界。 我们报告了两个互补的指标：严格通过率（要求试验中所有适用谓词均通过）和原子谓词均值（衡量适用谓词的平均通过率）。

paragraphs.en: Trials are evaluated across three primary execution conditions with skills injection disabled, comprising 36 instances per condition: TaskVM, Direct-CUA, and Planner-CUA. Direct-CUA perceives raw screenshots and dispatches actions directly, receiving interventions as natural language messages delivered to an interactive chat drawer. Planner-CUA formulates hierarchical natural language plans before dispatching actions. All conditions execute against identical hidden-oracle world contracts, ensuring that evaluation relies on external ground truth rather than agent self-reports.
paragraphs.zh: 试验在三种主要执行条件下进行评估，且技能注入功能已禁用，每种条件包含 36 个实例：TaskVM、Direct-CUA 和 Planner-CUA。 Direct-CUA 能够感知原始屏幕截图并直接执行操作，同时以自然语言消息的形式接收干预信息，这些信息会发送到交互式聊天抽屉中。 Planner-CUA 在执行操作前会先制定分层的自然语言计划。 所有条件均基于相同的隐藏神谕世界合同执行，从而确保评估依赖外部基准事实，而非智能体的自我报告。

paragraphs.en: All LLM roles in all conditions ran the same production model (GPT-5.6-sol) through the same internal inference endpoint, so condition differences reflect the interaction and runtime architecture rather than model choice. In the TaskVM condition the model serves four prompted roles: state compiler, task architect, CUA executor, and an independent model verifier reading fresh screenshots; Direct-CUA and Planner-CUA use the same model for a single agentic loop (with a planning preamble in the latter) over identical environment seeds. Template Control is a scripted gesture driver with zero LLM calls. The user-facing runtime sees only rendered pixels and standard input gestures, whereas oracle-only capabilities (state resets, internal-state reads, event injection) live in an isolated evaluation harness; every trial manifest records the model identity, ledger call counts per role, and wall time, and the frozen run artifacts are retained in the consolidated archive (full prompts and generation settings in the supplementary package).
paragraphs.zh: 在所有条件下，所有 LLM 角色均通过相同的内部推理端点运行同一生产模型（GPT-5.6-sol），因此条件间的差异反映的是交互和运行时架构，而非模型选择。 在 TaskVM 条件下，该模型为四个提示角色提供服务：状态编译器、任务架构师、CUA 执行器，以及一个读取新鲜屏幕截图的独立模型验证器；Direct-CUA 和 Planner-CUA 则使用同一模型进行单一智能体循环（后者包含规划前奏），且环境种子完全相同。 模板控制是一个脚本化的手势驱动机制，不涉及任何 LLM 调用。 面向用户的运行时仅显示渲染后的像素和标准输入手势，而仅限“神谕”使用的能力（状态重置、内部状态读取、事件注入）则存在于一个隔离的评估框架中；每次试验的日志都会记录模型身份、各角色的账本调用次数以及实际运行时间，且冻结的运行产物会被保留在整合存档中（完整提示词和生成设置见补充材料包）。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 reports the primary comparison across the 36 task instances, visualized in Figure 4 . On the skills-OFF main comparison, TaskVM obtained 21/36 strict passes (rate: 0.583) and an atomic predicate mean of 0.870, compared with 18/36 (0.500) and 0.761 for Direct-CUA, and 17/36 (0.472) and 0.737 for Planner-CUA. The advantage amounts to +0.083 (+16.6%) over Direct-CUA and +0.111 (+23.5%) over Planner-CUA in strict pass rate, alongside +0.109 (+14.3%) and +0.133 (+18.0%) in atomic predicate mean. Inspection of error traces indicates that baseline failures frequently stemmed from premature completion claims and collateral modifications. Direct-CUA often emitted stop tokens before asynchronous web updates persisted, and Planner-CUA altered adjacent form fields when re-planning. In contrast, TaskVM enforced witness predicates that confirmed persisted state before certifying completion. However, this verification property introduces operational overhead: TaskVM consumed 19,960 seconds of wall time across 1,126 model calls, about 2.2 times the wall time of Direct-CUA, reflecting the latency of round-trip state compilation and verification polling. We report this machine-side cost as a measured property of the automated harness; it cannot be decomposed here into user-facing costs, which the later studies measure on their own terms. Table 1 also documents Template Control (3/36 strict pass rate), included exclusively as an assembly sanity check; 101 of 108 trials failed at the architect stage due to a limitation in parsing Chinese-language goals, so it is not an empirical baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 表1报告了36个任务实例之间的主要对比结果，该结果在图4中进行了可视化展示。 在skills-OFF主对比中，TaskVM获得了21/36的严格通过率（比率：0.583）和0.870的平均原子谓词得分，而Direct-CUA为18/36（0.500）和0.761，Planner-CUA则为17/36（0.472）和0.737。 在严格通过率方面，TaskVM相比Direct-CUA的优势为+0.083（+16.6%），相比Planner-CUA的优势为+0.111（+23.5%）；在平均原子谓词得分方面，优势分别为+0.109（+14.3%）和+0.133（+18.0%）。 对错误轨迹的分析表明，基线模型失败的原因通常源于过早的完成声明以及附带性修改。 Direct-CUA常常在异步网页更新尚未生效前就发出停止标记，而Planner-CUA在重新规划时则会修改相邻的表单字段。 相比之下，TaskVM强制执行了见证谓词，在确认状态持续存在之前不会认证任务完成。 然而，这种验证特性带来了运行开销：TaskVM在1,126次模型调用中消耗了19,960秒的实际运行时间，约为Direct-CUA实际运行时间的2.2倍，这反映了往返状态编译和验证轮询的延迟。 我们将这一机器端的成本报告为自动化测试框架的一个可测量特性；在此无法将其分解为用户可见的成本，这些成本将在后续研究中按各自的标准进行测量。 表1还记录了模板控制（严格通过率为3/36），其仅作为组件健全性检查被纳入；由于解析中文目标存在限制，108次试验中有101次在架构阶段失败，因此它并非一个经验性的基线。

paragraphs.en: The predicate-level breakdown in Figure 4(b) localizes where the advantage originates. The largest source of separation is required_final_state , which TaskVM satisfied on 22 of 36 instances versus 20 for Direct-CUA and 17 for Planner-CUA. Two further observations concern recovery specifically. On reversible_restore , TaskVM restored the protected pre-state in 4 of 6 applicable trials, while Direct-CUA restored none of its 3 applicable trials and Planner-CUA none of its 5: in the adjudication records the baselines possess no restore verb at all, and on external_ownership_preservation they reach no testable scenario. TaskVM is also the only condition measured on all ten predicates, including 36/36 passes on pause_stop_boundary ; this full-spectrum measurability is itself a distinguishing property of contract-checked execution. This machine-side asymmetry, where recovery exists as an executable verb only under TaskVM, is mirrored later at the human layer: recovery operations were the most adopted governance functions in Stage 2 (Section 6 ) and the most demanded automation in Stage 3 (Section 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 图 4(b) 中的谓词级分解定位了优势的来源。 最大的分离来源是 required_final_state，TaskVM 在 36 个实例中满足了其中 22 个，而 Direct-CUA 为 20 个，Planner-CUA 为 17 个。 另外两个观察点专门涉及恢复问题。 在 reversible_restore 上，TaskVM 在 6 次适用试验中恢复了受保护的先前状态 4 次，而 Direct-CUA 在其 3 次适用试验中未恢复任何一次，Planner-CUA 在其 5 次试验中也未恢复任何一次：在裁决记录中，基线方法完全没有恢复动词，并且在 external_ownership_preservation 上它们未能达到任何可测试的场景。 TaskVM 也是唯一在所有十个谓词上均被测量的条件，包括在 pause_stop_boundary 上实现了 36/36 的通过率；这种全谱的可测量性本身便是合同检查执行的一个区分性特征。 这种机器端的不对称性——即恢复仅在 TaskVM 下作为一个可执行的动词存在——后来在人类层面也得以反映：恢复操作是第 2 阶段（第 6 节）中最被采用的治理功能，也是第 3 阶段（第 7 节）中最被需求的自动化功能。

sents.zh: TaskVM 也是唯一在所有十个谓词上均被测量的条件，包括在 pause_stop_boundary 上实现了 36/36 的通过率；这种全谱的可测量性本身便是合同检查执行的一个区分性特征。

sents.en: This machine-side asymmetry, where recovery exists as an executable verb only under TaskVM, is mirrored later at the human layer: recovery operations were the most adopted governance functions in Stage 2 (Section 6 ) and the most demanded automation in Stage 3 (Section 7 ).
sents.zh: 这种机器端的不对称性——即恢复仅在 TaskVM 下作为一个可执行的动词存在——后来在人类层面也得以反映：恢复操作是第 2 阶段（第 6 节）中最被采用的治理功能，也是第 3 阶段（第 7 节）中最被需求的自动化功能。

paragraphs.en: To understand where state contracts provide utility, Table 2 partitions evaluation across task zones in a separate skills-ON comparison wave. Zone-S comprises five structural and execution families (Loop blv , Fan-out fav , Partial-failure pfv , Cross-app cav , Sequence sqv ), while Zone-G comprises seven governance-dense families (Conflict cfv , UI-drift drv , Interrupt itv , Local-patch lpv , Goal-patch gpv , Irreversible irv , Rollback rbv ) that specifically test user intervention intent landing, supersession, pause boundaries, and reversible restore; the same family-to-zone dictionary drives Figure 8 and Appendix Table 8 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了解状态合同在何处提供效用，表 2 在一个独立的技能开启（skills-ON）对比波中，按任务区域划分了评估。 Zone-S 包含五个结构和执行家族（Loop blv、Fan-out fav、Partial-failure pfv、Cross-app cav、Sequence sqv），而 Zone-G 则包含七个治理密集家族（Conflict cfv、UI-drift drv、Interrupt itv、Local-patch lpv、Goal-patch gpv、Irreversible irv、Rollback rbv），这些家族专门测试用户干预意图的落地、替代、暂停边界以及可逆恢复；相同的家族到区域字典也用于生成图 8 和附录表 8。

paragraphs.en: In Zone-S, TaskVM achieved a strict pass rate of 0.556 (5/9) and an atomic mean of 0.852, compared with 0.467 (7/15) and 0.733 for Direct-CUA, and 0.533 (8/15) and 0.767 for Planner-CUA. In Zone-G, TaskVM achieved a strict pass rate of 0.714 (10/14) and an atomic mean of 0.922, compared with 0.571 (12/21) and 0.822 for Direct-CUA, and 0.476 (10/21) and 0.797 for Planner-CUA. On these descriptive rates, the advantage over both baselines is larger in Zone-G than in Zone-S. The same governance dimension later separates the two interfaces for human users: in Stage 2, participants reported their largest perceived-control gain on the ability to stop and redirect the agent (Section 6 ). Notably, the analyzed subsets and denominators differ across execution conditions (e.g., 9 vs 15 and 14 vs 21). These unmatched rates are reported to document the tested populations; missing or excluded cases are not treated as zero, and the difference between unmatched rates is not interpreted as a matched statistical contrast.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Zone-S 中，TaskVM 的严格通过率达到了 0.556（5/9），原子均值为 0.852；相比之下，Direct-CUA 的严格通过率为 0.467（7/15），原子均值为 0.733，而 Planner-CUA 的严格通过率为 0.533（8/15），原子均值为 0.767。 在 Zone-G 中，TaskVM 的严格通过率达到了 0.714（10/14），原子均值为 0.922；相比之下，Direct-CUA 的严格通过率为 0.571（12/21），原子均值为 0.822，而 Planner-CUA 的严格通过率为 0.476（10/21），原子均值为 0.797。 从这些描述性比率来看，与两种基线方法相比，Zone-G 中的优势比 Zone-S 更大。 随后，相同的治理维度将两种接口在人类用户层面区分开来：在阶段 2 中，参与者报告称他们在停止和重新引导智能体的能力上获得了最大的感知控制增益（第 6 节）。 值得注意的是，所分析的子集和分母在不同执行条件下存在差异（例如，9 与 15，以及 14 与 21）。 这些未匹配的比率被报告出来是为了记录受测群体；缺失或排除的案例不被视为零，且未匹配比率之间的差异也不被解释为匹配后的统计对比。

paragraphs.en: We examine whether procedural skills injection harms TaskVM’s contract faithfulness and whether TaskVM remains non-inferior to its strongest baseline once skills are enabled (Table 3 ). Paired across 21 instances between the two waves, skills injection flipped four instances in TaskVM’s favor and three against it, a modest net gain of +1; neither CUA baseline showed any net change. Because the skills-OFF and skills-ON waves differ in coverage, we additionally evaluate non-inferiority within the same skills-ON wave on contract-faithful execution (CFE), a per-instance correctness measure derived from the task boundary semantics of each family. The two analysis collections are explicitly distinct: the strict-COV index retains only fully measured cells (23 of 36 for TaskVM under skills-ON), whereas the CFE comparison additionally admits the protocol’s per-family fallback judgments (e.g., boundary arcs judged from pre-boundary oracle segments), yielding 35 comparable instance clusters paired between TaskVM and Direct-CUA; the 35 are instance-level clusters, not a third task set. A cluster bootstrap over these 35 paired clusters (10,000 resamples, fixed seed) yields a point estimate of the TaskVM minus Direct-CUA difference of +0.0571, with a one-sided 95% lower bound of − 0.0857 -0.0857 . This lower bound clears the margin of 10 percentage points specified in our evaluation protocol, establishing non-inferiority at that margin; sensitivity analyses at 5 and 7.5 points remain inconclusive, and the verdict also holds at 15 points. Among the eight discordant clusters, TaskVM alone succeeded on five instances concentrated in drift-robust rescheduling and sequential contract chains ( drv-01 , drv-03 , sqv-01 through sqv-03 ), while Direct-CUA alone succeeded on three instances involving confusable references and retargeting ( gpv-03 , lpv-03 , pfv-03 ). Skills injection therefore does not degrade TaskVM below its strongest baseline on contract-faithful execution, though the inconclusive stricter margins call for larger paired samples. This result supersedes an earlier cross-wave draft analysis that was inconclusive; the final protocol and its sensitivity margins are documented in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 我们检验了程序性技能注入是否损害 TaskVM 的合同忠实性，以及启用技能后 TaskVM 是否仍不低于其最强的基线模型（表 3）。 在两波实验中，21 个实例的配对比较显示：技能注入使其中 4 个实例对 TaskVM 有利，3 个实例则不利，净增益为 +1；CUA 基线模型均未出现任何净变化。 由于技能关闭（skills-OFF）和技能开启（skills-ON）两波实验的覆盖范围不同，我们进一步在同一技能开启波中，基于合同忠实执行（CFE）评估非劣性，该指标是从每个任务族的任务边界语义中推导出的实例级正确性度量。 这两组分析明确区分：严格覆盖（strict-COV）指数仅保留完全测量的单元格（TaskVM 在技能开启状态下为 36 个中的 23 个），而 CFE 比较则额外纳入协议中每个任务族的回退判断（例如，基于边界前预言机段判断的边界弧），从而得到 TaskVM 与 Direct-CUA 之间配对的 35 个可比较实例簇；这 35 个簇是实例级的簇，而非第三个任务集。 对这 35 个配对簇进行簇自助法分析（10,000 次重采样，固定种子），得到 TaskVM 与 Direct-CUA 差异的点估计值为 +0.0571，单侧 95% 下限为 −0.0857。 该下限超过了我们评估协议中规定的 10 个百分点的阈值，从而在该阈值上确立了非劣性；在 5 和 7.5 个百分点的敏感性分析中结果仍不确定，但在 15 个百分点时结论依然成立。 在八个不一致的簇中，TaskVM 单独成功处理了 5 个实例，这些实例主要集中在漂移鲁棒的重新调度和顺序合同链（drv-01、drv-03、sqv-01 至 sqv-03）；而 Direct-CUA 则单独成功处理了 3 个涉及易混淆引用和重定向的实例（gpv-03、lpv-03、pfv-03）。 因此，技能注入并未使 TaskVM 在合同忠实执行方面的表现低于其最强的基线模型，但较严格的阈值仍得出不确定结论，这需要更大规模的配对样本。 这一结果取代了此前跨波次草案分析中不确定的结论；最终协议及其敏感性阈值已记录在附录 B 中。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the frozen benchmark waves, a development-era stress tier probed governance durability under adversarial goal mutations with skills enabled throughout. The tier comprises 18 variants at difficulty levels L3 and L4, covering conflict injection, goal repair, and cross-session intervention, adjudicated under a majority criterion in which a frozen pass verdict is never reversed. Eleven of 12 L3 variants and all 6 L4 variants passed. The single L3 failure is rbvl3 , a rollback-compensation family blocked by a signing-window race condition that remains an open, documented defect. We report this tier as robustness evidence rather than held-out results. The placement of the sole failure is nonetheless informative: rollback is simultaneously the hardest capability to make reliable and, as the next two sections show, the capability human participants used and requested the most (Sections 6 and 7 ); we return to this tension in the Discussion.
paragraphs.zh: 在冻结基准波之外，一个开发时代的压力层级通过全程启用技能，在对抗性目标突变下测试了治理的耐用性。 该层级包含难度等级为 L3 和 L4 的 18 种变体，涵盖冲突注入、目标修复和跨会话干预，并根据多数标准进行裁决，其中冻结通过的判定绝不会被推翻。 12 个 L3 变体中有 11 个通过，所有 6 个 L4 变体均通过。 唯一未通过的 L3 变体是 rbvl3，这是一个回滚补偿系列，因签名窗口竞赛条件而被阻断，该问题仍是一个已记录但尚未解决的缺陷。 我们将此层级报告为稳健性证据，而非预留测试结果。 尽管如此，这一唯一失败的位置仍具有启发性：回滚既是实现可靠性的最困难能力，正如接下来两节所示，也是人类参与者使用最多、需求最强的能力（第 6 节和第 7 节）；我们将在讨论部分再次回到这一矛盾。

paragraphs.en: While automated technical evaluations establish system capabilities across benchmark suites, evaluating human governance requires empirical observation of human operators. We conducted a controlled, within-subject laboratory user study with 37 participants to evaluate how human operators understand, steer, and verify multi-application agent workflows. The study investigates how compiling live application state into an editable governance surface influences perceived recovery control, trust, and the alignment between confidence and understanding compared to conversational agent interfaces.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然自动化技术评估能够确定系统在各类基准测试套件中的能力，但要对人类治理进行评估，则需要对人类操作者进行实证观察。 我们开展了一项受控的、被试内实验室用户研究，共有 37 名参与者，旨在评估人类操作者如何理解、引导和验证多应用智能体的工作流程。 该研究探讨了将实时应用状态整合到可编辑的治理界面中，相较于对话式智能体界面，会对感知到的恢复控制能力、信任度以及信心与理解之间的契合度产生何种影响。

sents.zh: 虽然自动化技术评估能够确定系统在各类基准测试套件中的能力，但要对人类治理进行评估，则需要对人类操作者进行实证观察。

paragraphs.en: The primary objective of the user study is to evaluate the interactive efficacy and cognitive impact of task-state governance during collaborative execution. We formulate four research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 用户研究的主要目标是评估任务状态治理在协作执行过程中的交互效率与认知影响。 我们提出了四个研究问题：

sents.en: The primary objective of the user study is to evaluate the interactive efficacy and cognitive impact of task-state governance during collaborative execution.
sents.zh: 用户研究的主要目标是评估任务状态治理在协作执行过程中的交互效率与认知影响。

sents.en: We formulate four research questions:
sents.zh: 我们提出了四个研究问题：

paragraphs.en: RQ1 (State Understanding and Confidence Gap): Does task-state governance descriptively narrow the gap between user confidence and objective understanding of application state?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题1（状态理解与信心差距）：任务状态治理是否在描述性层面缩小了用户信心与应用状态客观理解之间的差距？

paragraphs.en: RQ2 (Perceived Recovery Control and Adoption): Does exposing transactional checkpoints and reversibility locks improve perceived recovery control and encourage adoption of recovery operations?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题2（感知恢复控制与采用）：展示事务检查点和可逆性锁是否有助于提升用户对恢复控制的感知，并促进恢复操作的采用？

paragraphs.en: RQ3 (Interaction Cost under Execution Control): When the environment and the agent’s replayed trajectory are held constant across conditions, what interaction latency and workload trade-offs emerge from state-level governance?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题3（执行控制下的交互成本）：当环境与智能体的重播轨迹在各条件下保持恒定时，状态级治理会引发哪些交互延迟与工作负载之间的权衡？

paragraphs.en: RQ4 (Trust and Subjective Satisfaction): Does the task-state governance console foster higher subjective trust and satisfaction compared to conversational supervision?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题4（信任与主观满意度）：与对话式监督相比，任务状态治理控制台能否促进更高的主观信任度和满意度？

paragraphs.en: We hypothesized that TaskVM would significantly increase perceived recovery control and reported trust while narrowing the observed overconfidence gap. Furthermore, we anticipated that governing state would introduce an observable interaction latency trade-off even with the environment and the replayed trajectory held identical by design.
paragraphs.zh: 我们假设，TaskVM 会显著提升感知到的恢复控制感和报告出的信任度，同时缩小观察到的过度自信差距。 此外，我们还预期，即使环境与重播轨迹在设计上保持完全一致，治理状态仍会带来可观察的交互延迟权衡。

paragraphs.en: We recruited 37 participants through a public research-volunteer group maintained by our laboratory; membership in the group is open to anyone, although in practice it skews toward university students and researchers (Appendix M ). 19 participants were assigned to the TaskVM-first order and 18 to the Conversational-first order. All participants completed both conditions and enter the analysis as a within-subject sample. Self-reported demographics and agent-related background, collected post-study through voluntary channels, are detailed in Appendix M . Of the 37 completers, 36 disclosed gender, age, and affiliation (15 female, 21 male; ages 18–42, M = 24.7 M{=}24.7 ) and 35 completed the background questionnaire. The sample was technically literate but predominantly novice with respect to GUI agents: only 2/35 reported direct computer-use/GUI-agent professional background, and 14/35 had never used a GUI agent or had tried one only once or twice.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过实验室维护的一个公开研究志愿者小组招募了 37 名参与者；该小组向所有人开放，但实际上以大学生和研究人员为主（附录 M）。其中 19 名参与者被分配到“任务VM优先”顺序组，18 名分配到“对话优先”顺序组。 所有参与者都完成了两种实验条件，并作为受试者内样本进入分析。 通过研究结束后自愿渠道收集的自我报告人口统计信息和智能体相关背景信息详见附录 M。 在 37 名完成者中，有 36 人披露了性别、年龄和所属机构（15 名女性，21 名男性；年龄 18–42 岁，M = 24.7 M{=}24.7），35 人完成了背景问卷。 该样本群体在技术方面具备一定素养，但在 GUI 智能体方面主要是新手：仅 2/35 人报告有直接使用计算机或 GUI 智能体的专业背景，而 14/35 人从未使用过 GUI 智能体，或仅尝试过一次或两次。

paragraphs.en: Conversational CUA (Baseline): Participants supervise an agent through an application screencast accompanied by an interactive chat drawer, receiving conversational progress updates and issuing natural language steering directives.
paragraphs.zh: 对话式CUA（基线）：参与者通过一个应用程序屏幕录像进行监督，该录像配有交互式聊天抽屉，同时接收对话进展更新并下达自然语言引导指令。

paragraphs.en: TaskVM (Ours): Participants govern execution through the governance cockpit (Figure 2 ): the editable task-state zone displays desired, preserve, and observed fields beside the live application, the progress zone exposes role status and verification reports, and the global governance zone provides lifecycle controls, checkpoints, and rollback.
paragraphs.zh: TaskVM（我们的方案）：参与者通过治理驾驶舱（图 2）管理执行流程：可编辑的任务状态区在实时应用旁显示期望、保留和观察到的字段；进度区展示角色状态和验证报告；全局治理区则提供生命周期控制、检查点和回滚功能。

paragraphs.en: Participants performed eight representative task scenarios spanning collaborative office productivity, event scheduling, customer support record updates, and social communication. Each scenario encompassed three distinct phases: an initial autonomous execution phase across multiple applications, an injected environmental perturbation such as dynamic UI drift or an unexpected record conflict introduced by a simulated collaborator, and a required user intervention prompting selective modification of target fields while preserving existing records. Task order and condition assignments were counterbalanced across participants (19 TaskVM-first, 18 Conversational-first) using Latin square permutations.
paragraphs.zh: 参与者执行了八个具有代表性的任务场景，涵盖协作办公效率、活动安排、客户支持记录更新以及社交沟通。 每个场景包含三个不同阶段：首先是在多个应用程序中自主执行的初始阶段；随后是人为引入的环境扰动，例如动态的界面变化或由模拟协作方引发的意外记录冲突；最后是要求用户进行干预，在保留现有记录的同时选择性地修改目标字段。 任务顺序和条件分配通过拉丁方排列法在参与者之间进行了平衡处理（19人先执行任务VM，18人先执行对话任务）。

sents.en: Participants performed eight representative task scenarios spanning collaborative office productivity, event scheduling, customer support record updates, and social communication.
sents.zh: 参与者执行了八个具有代表性的任务场景，涵盖协作办公效率、活动安排、客户支持记录更新以及社交沟通。

sents.en: Each scenario encompassed three distinct phases: an initial autonomous execution phase across multiple applications, an injected environmental perturbation such as dynamic UI drift or an unexpected record conflict introduced by a simulated collaborator, and a required user intervention prompting selective modification of target fields while preserving existing records.
sents.zh: 每个场景包含三个不同阶段：首先是在多个应用程序中自主执行的初始阶段；随后是人为引入的环境扰动，例如动态的界面变化或由模拟协作方引发的意外记录冲突；最后是要求用户进行干预，在保留现有记录的同时选择性地修改目标字段。

sents.en: Task order and condition assignments were counterbalanced across participants (19 TaskVM-first, 18 Conversational-first) using Latin square permutations.
sents.zh: 任务顺序和条件分配通过拉丁方排列法在参与者之间进行了平衡处理（19人先执行任务VM，18人先执行对话任务）。

paragraphs.en: Each condition began with its own onboarding sequence containing an unscored training task ( r8-train ) so that participants practiced both interfaces to the same degree, followed by a six-minute think-aloud free-exploration period. In the formal battery each participant completed three of the eight tasks per condition (Table 9 ); task–condition–order assignments followed the Latin-square schedule, and read/write probe slots were allocated deterministically per task slot in a balanced rotation, so probe exposure was independent of performance. The condition-end questionnaire (all subjective scales described below) was administered once at the end of each condition; there were no per-task questionnaires. The experimenter intervened only at scripted perturbation points and through a fallback prompt (e.g., asking the participant to verify the selected item when the scripted model error did not occur), applied identically in both conditions; a logged help channel gave direct guidance on request, and such help was recorded as help usage. Participant inputs that did not match a scripted replay branch were steered back onto the canonical path by the operator, and these mismatch and resume events are annotated in the session records. Sessions were run individually.
paragraphs.zh: 每个条件都从各自的上手流程开始，其中包含一个未评分的训练任务（r8-train），以便参与者对两个界面进行同等程度的练习，随后是六分钟的“出声思考”自由探索阶段。 在正式测试中，每位参与者需完成每个条件下的八个任务中的三个（表9）；任务–条件–顺序的分配遵循拉丁方设计，而读/写探针环节则根据每个任务槽位按平衡轮转法确定分配，因此探针接触情况与表现无关。 条件结束问卷（下文描述的所有主观量表）在每个条件结束时仅发放一次；没有针对单个任务的问卷。 实验者仅在预设的扰动节点进行干预，并通过备用提示（例如，当预设模型错误未发生时，要求参与者验证所选项目）介入，且两种条件下的干预方式完全一致；一个记录在案的帮助渠道可在请求时提供直接指导，此类帮助被记录为帮助使用行为。 若参与者的输入与预设的重播分支不匹配，操作员会将其引导回标准路径，这些不匹配和恢复事件均会在会话记录中标注。 所有会话均以个人形式进行。
