sents.zh: 实验者仅在预设的扰动节点进行干预，并通过备用提示（例如，当预设模型错误未发生时，要求参与者验证所选项目）介入，且两种条件下的干预方式完全一致；一个记录在案的帮助渠道可在请求时提供直接指导，此类帮助被记录为帮助使用行为。

sents.en: Participant inputs that did not match a scripted replay branch were steered back onto the canonical path by the operator, and these mismatch and resume events are annotated in the session records.
sents.zh: 若参与者的输入与预设的重播分支不匹配，操作员会将其引导回标准路径，这些不匹配和恢复事件均会在会话记录中标注。

sents.en: Sessions were run individually.
sents.zh: 所有会话均以个人形式进行。

paragraphs.en: To isolate the effect of interaction representations on human perception and behavior, the study executed on a high-fidelity Wizard-of-Oz replay rig. Underlying application screens and event streams were pre-recorded from authentic runs on a simulated application suite, with every frame undergoing automated semantic verification to ensure visible text, status bar timestamps, and pixel evidence aligned with the experimental script. When participants intervened, the platform matched the input against a canonical script of branching paths, substituting the runtime engine without altering the study runner ( ConditionRuntime , StudyRunner ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了将交互表示对人类感知和行为的影响单独研究，该实验在一个高保真的“奥兹魔法师”重播系统上执行。 底层的应用屏幕和事件流是从模拟应用套件的真实运行中预先录制的，每一帧都经过了自动语义验证，以确保可见文本、状态栏的时间戳以及像素证据与实验脚本一致。 当参与者进行干预时，平台会将输入与分支路径的标准脚本进行匹配，并替换运行时引擎，但不会改变研究运行器（ConditionRuntime，StudyRunner）。

paragraphs.en: The replay protocol fixes three things identically across arms: the environment’s event sequence, the agent’s recorded steps, and the timing and manifestation of errors. It deliberately fixes nothing about the participant’s own intervention: the write-probe score evaluates what the participant did at the intervention point, so paired outcomes legitimately diverge across conditions. Consistent with this design, marginal pass rates are identical (34.3%, 12 of 35 scored probes per arm at the boundary; 51.4%, 18 of 35 at trial end) while the paired record is fully discordant (Section 6.6 ): every pass was earned by different participants in the two arms. We therefore read the identical margins strictly as evidence that neither arm offered systematically easier intervention opportunities, not as evidence that participants experienced identical outcomes, and not as evidence that the two interfaces would execute with equivalent competence outside the rig.
paragraphs.zh: 重播协议在所有分支中一致地固定了三个要素：环境的事件序列、智能体记录的操作步骤，以及错误的出现时间和表现形式。 该协议刻意不固定参与者自身干预的任何内容：写入探针评分评估的是参与者在干预点所执行的操作，因此配对结果在不同条件下出现差异是合理的。 与此设计一致，边际通过率完全相同（每个分支在边界处有 35 个探针得分，其中 12 个通过，即 34.3%；在试验结束时则有 18 个通过，即 51.4%），但配对记录却完全不一致（第 6.6 节）：两个分支中的每一次通过都由不同的参与者完成。 因此，我们将相同的边际结果严格视为以下证据：两个分支均未系统性地提供更简单的干预机会，而非参与者经历了相同的结果，也非两种接口在实验环境之外会以同等能力运行。

paragraphs.en: Subjective scales were collected once per condition through the condition-end instrument (verbatim item texts, sources, and composite rules in Table 12 ). The NASA Task Load Index (NASA-TLX) was administered as six 0–100 sliders and scored as the unweighted mean (RTLX); the performance slider runs from Perfect (0) to Failure (100), so all six dimensions share the same demand direction with no post-hoc inversion. UMUX-Lite, the two-item short form of the Usability Metric for User Experience, is rescaled to 0–100 by mean ⁡ ( items − 1 ) / 6 × 100 \mathrm{mean}(\mathrm{items}-1)/6\times 100 . Recovery control is a study-specific composite of four items (influence, stop/redirect, correct, overall). Trust is a two-item composite (trust, rely) adapted from the Trust in Automation instrument; perceived transparency is a three-item predictability subset of the same instrument with one reverse-scored item. Support satisfaction adapts the three After-Scenario Questionnaire items to the condition block. Read probes (three questions each on committed effects, effective goals, and governance facts) were embedded in drift-triggered trials and preceded by a single confidence rating (0–100) for the whole probe; write probes score the participant’s own intervention at the scripting boundary and at trial end against the frozen expectation.
paragraphs.zh: 通过条件结束工具（表 12 中的逐字项目文本、来源和组合规则）在每种条件下收集一次主观量表数据。 NASA 任务负荷指数（NASA-TLX）以六个 0–100 的滑块形式实施，并计算为未经权重的平均值（RTLX）；绩效滑块从“完美”（0）到“失败”（100），因此所有六个维度的需求方向一致，无需事后反转。 UMUX-Lite 是“用户体验度量标准”的两项简短版本，通过公式 \mathrm{mean}(\mathrm{items}-1)/6\times 100 重新缩放到 0–100 范围。 恢复控制是一项研究特定的组合指标，由四个项目（影响、停止/重定向、纠正、总体）组成。 信任是一个包含两个项目的组合指标（信任、依赖），改编自“自动化信任”工具；感知透明度则是同一工具中三个可预测性项目的子集，其中有一个反向计分项目。 支持满意度将“场景后问卷”的三个项目适配到该条件模块中。 阅读探针（每个探针包含三个问题，分别涉及已承诺的影响、有效目标和管理事实）被嵌入在由偏移触发的试验中，并在试验前要求参与者对整个探针进行单次信心评级（0–100）；写作探针则在脚本边界和试验结束时评估参与者自身干预与固定预期之间的差异。

paragraphs.en: All inferential analyses use the participant as the unit: two-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests for scalar measures and exact McNemar tests for paired binary outcomes (scipy, version pinned in the analysis environment). Paired differences are summarized by d z = mean ⁡ ( d i ) / sd ⁡ ( d i ) d_{z}=\mathrm{mean}(d_{i})/\mathrm{sd}(d_{i}) ; reported confidence intervals are t t -based intervals of the mean paired difference. Missing responses per measure are reported in the table (valid pairs range from 34 to 37 for write probes and 8 for read-probe pairing); zero differences are handled by the implementation’s defaults. We report the complete set of planned comparisons without selective omission, with unadjusted p p -values interpreted alongside effect sizes, and we do not retroactively designate a subset as the sole primary endpoints. All numbers are reproducible from the consolidated archive’s analysis scripts.

paragraphs.en: Table 4 summarizes the primary subjective psychometric scales and objective behavioral metrics across the 37 participants. Analysis rules follow Section 6.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 表 4 总结了 37 名参与者中主要的主观心理测量量表和客观行为指标。 分析规则遵循第 6.5 节。

sents.en: Table 4 summarizes the primary subjective psychometric scales and objective behavioral metrics across the 37 participants.
sents.zh: 表 4 总结了 37 名参与者中主要的主观心理测量量表和客观行为指标。

sents.en: Analysis rules follow Section 6.5 .

paragraphs.en: Participants reported significantly higher perceived recovery control under TaskVM than under the conversational baseline. On a composite of four study-specific recovery-control items (1 to 7), TaskVM achieved a mean rating of 5.56 compared to 4.63 for the conversational baseline ( Δ = + 0.93 \Delta=+0.93 , Wilcoxon p = .0050 p=.0050 , d z = + 0.51 d_{z}=+0.51 , with 22 participants favoring TaskVM versus 13 favoring Conversational CUA). All four constituent items demonstrated statistically significant advantages for TaskVM: ability to stop and redirect the agent ( rc_stop : 5.68 vs 4.43, Δ = + 1.24 \Delta=+1.24 , p = .0035 p=.0035 , d z = + 0.58 d_{z}=+0.58 ), general recovery control ( rc_overall : 5.35 vs 4.35, Δ = + 1.00 \Delta=+1.00 , p = .0099 p=.0099 , d z = + 0.44 d_{z}=+0.44 ), ability to correct mistakes ( rc_correct : 5.49 vs 4.59, Δ = + 0.89 \Delta=+0.89 , p = .0160 p=.0160 , d z = + 0.42 d_{z}=+0.42 ), and perceived influence over agent actions ( rc_influence : 5.73 vs 5.14, Δ = + 0.59 \Delta=+0.59 , p = .0475 p=.0475 , d z = + 0.35 d_{z}=+0.35 ). This perceived empowerment was accompanied by concrete control use. Goal interventions (pause, edit, resume) were exercised by design in every task. Beyond them, 11 of 37 participants issued at least one rollback (reset) in the TaskVM condition, totaling 17 rollback events against 2 participants and 4 events in the conversational baseline; 13 of the 17 TaskVM events, issued by 8 of the 11 participants, occurred outside the two tasks that scripted an undo request (Table 9 ). This asymmetric adoption mirrors the machine-side asymmetry established in Section 5 , where recovery existed as an executable verb only under TaskVM; what the benchmark showed baselines cannot do became, for participants, the capability they reached for first. We emphasize that this reflects perceived recovery control and control use; the replayed trajectory the participants watched was identical across conditions, so these differences cannot be attributed to what the two arms showed them.
paragraphs.zh: 参与者报告称，在 TaskVM 条件下，他们感知到的恢复控制能力显著高于对话基准条件。 在由四项研究特定的恢复控制条目（评分范围 1 至 7）组成的综合指标中，TaskVM 的平均评分为 5.56，而对话基准条件的平均评分为 4.63（Δ = +0.93，Wilcoxon p = .0050，d_z = +0.51；其中 22 名参与者更偏好 TaskVM，13 名更偏好对话 CUA）。 所有四项组成条目均显示出 TaskVM 的统计显著优势：停止并重新引导智能体的能力（rc_stop：5.68 vs 4.43，Δ = +1.24，p = .0035，d_z = +0.58）、整体恢复控制能力（rc_overall：5.35 vs 4.35，Δ = +1.00，p = .0099，d_z = +0.44）、纠正错误的能力（rc_correct：5.49 vs 4.59，Δ = +0.89，p = .0160，d_z = +0.42），以及对智能体行为的感知影响力（rc_influence：5.73 vs 5.14，Δ = +0.59，p = .0475，d_z = +0.35）。 这种感知到的赋权伴随着具体的控制行为。 根据设计，所有任务中都必须执行目标干预（暂停、编辑、恢复）。 除此之外，在 TaskVM 条件下，37 名参与者中有 11 人至少执行了一次回滚（重置），共发生 17 次回滚事件；而在对话基准条件下，仅有 2 名参与者发生了 4 次回滚事件。TaskVM 条件下的 17 次事件中，有 13 次由 11 名参与者中的 8 人执行，且发生在未预设撤销请求的两项任务之外（表 9）。 这种不对称的使用模式反映了第 5 节中已确立的机器侧不对称性：恢复功能仅在 TaskVM 条件下作为可执行的动词存在；基准测试显示基准条件无法实现的功能，反而成为参与者首先尝试使用的能力。 我们强调，这反映的是感知到的恢复控制与控制使用行为；参与者所观看的重播轨迹在所有条件下均完全相同，因此这些差异不能归因于两种条件向他们展示的内容不同。

sents.zh: 根据设计，所有任务中都必须执行目标干预（暂停、编辑、恢复）。

sents.en: Beyond them, 11 of 37 participants issued at least one rollback (reset) in the TaskVM condition, totaling 17 rollback events against 2 participants and 4 events in the conversational baseline; 13 of the 17 TaskVM events, issued by 8 of the 11 participants, occurred outside the two tasks that scripted an undo request (Table 9 ).
sents.zh: 除此之外，在 TaskVM 条件下，37 名参与者中有 11 人至少执行了一次回滚（重置），共发生 17 次回滚事件；而在对话基准条件下，仅有 2 名参与者发生了 4 次回滚事件。TaskVM 条件下的 17 次事件中，有 13 次由 11 名参与者中的 8 人执行，且发生在未预设撤销请求的两项任务之外（表 9）。

sents.en: This asymmetric adoption mirrors the machine-side asymmetry established in Section 5 , where recovery existed as an executable verb only under TaskVM; what the benchmark showed baselines cannot do became, for participants, the capability they reached for first.
sents.zh: 这种不对称的使用模式反映了第 5 节中已确立的机器侧不对称性：恢复功能仅在 TaskVM 条件下作为可执行的动词存在；基准测试显示基准条件无法实现的功能，反而成为参与者首先尝试使用的能力。

sents.en: We emphasize that this reflects perceived recovery control and control use; the replayed trajectory the participants watched was identical across conditions, so these differences cannot be attributed to what the two arms showed them.
sents.zh: 我们强调，这反映的是感知到的恢复控制与控制使用行为；参与者所观看的重播轨迹在所有条件下均完全相同，因此这些差异不能归因于两种条件向他们展示的内容不同。

paragraphs.en: Objective intervention outcomes corroborate this framing as a manipulation check rather than a treatment effect (Table 4 ). At the intervention boundary, 12 participants passed only under TaskVM and 12 only under the baseline, 10 failed under both, and 0 passed under both ( n = 34 n=34 pairs with both arms scored); at trial end the corresponding split is 18, 18, 1, and 0 across all 37 pairs. Every pass was therefore discordant under trajectories the rig held identical, indicating that whether an intervention landed tracked individual intervention behavior rather than arm-level execution differences.
paragraphs.zh: 干预的客观结果证实，这种设定应被视为一种操控性检验，而非治疗效应（表4）。 在干预边界处，有12名参与者仅在TaskVM条件下通过，12人仅在基线条件下通过，10人在两种条件下均未通过，而0人在两种条件下均通过（n = 34对双臂均有得分的参与者）；到试验结束时，在所有37对参与者中，相应的分布为18、18、1和0。 因此，在所有轨迹中，每次通过的结果都不一致，表明干预是否生效取决于个体的干预行为，而非双臂执行层面的差异。

paragraphs.en: Subjective trust and post-task satisfaction were significantly higher under TaskVM. On a two-item trust composite (trust and reliance items) adapted from the Trust in Automated Systems instrument, TaskVM attained a mean rating of 5.54 versus 4.36 for the conversational baseline ( Δ = + 1.18 \Delta=+1.18 , p = .0030 p=.0030 , d z = + 0.55 d_{z}=+0.55 , with 21 participants rating TaskVM higher versus 7 rating Conversational CUA higher). Support satisfaction measured through an adapted three-item After-Scenario Questionnaire covering ease, completion time, and informational support was likewise significantly higher (5.66 vs 4.95, Δ = + 0.70 \Delta=+0.70 , p = .0222 p=.0222 , d z = + 0.42 d_{z}=+0.42 ). Perceived transparency, computed from a three-item predictability subset with one reverse-scored item, was directionally higher (5.07 vs 4.50, Δ = + 0.57 \Delta=+0.57 , p = .0809 p=.0809 , d z = + 0.30 d_{z}=+0.30 ), and usability on UMUX-Lite, rescaled to a 0 to 100 range through the standard two-item transformation, followed the same directional pattern without reaching significance (70.72 vs 60.14, Δ = + 10.58 \Delta=+10.58 , p = .0881 p=.0881 , d z = + 0.33 d_{z}=+0.33 ).

paragraphs.en: Task-state governance descriptively reduced the observed confidence-accuracy gap. During drift trials where objective read probes were administered, participants reported subjective confidence ratings before submitting answers. Under Conversational CUA, participants reported a mean confidence of 70.8% while achieving an actual all-correct accuracy of 45.0%, producing an overconfidence gap of +25.8 percentage points. Under TaskVM, participants reported a comparable mean confidence of 70.4% but achieved an actual accuracy of 57.1%, narrowing the overconfidence gap to +13.2 percentage points. 1 1 1 All-correct accuracies used in the gap exclude responses missing the confidence rating: 12/21 (57.1%) under TaskVM and 9/20 (45.0%) under the baseline. Counting all answered probes yields 13/22 (59.1%) for TaskVM; the single TaskVM response lacking a confidence rating accounts for the denominator difference. On individual probe questions, TaskVM achieved an accuracy of 84.8% (56/66) versus 73.3% (44/60) for Conversational CUA across committed effects, effective goals, and governance facts. However, because drift events triggered probes on a subset of trials, matched participant pairs were limited ( n = 8 n=8 , Wilcoxon p = 1.0 p=1.0 , d z = + 0.10 d_{z}=+0.10 ). Consequently, this probe accuracy stands as directional evidence rather than a statistically confirmed gain in state understanding, and the narrower gap represents a descriptive reduction in overconfidence rather than established calibration. Furthermore, participants in the conversational condition left twice as many probes unanswered (6 vs 3), frequently chatting past probe triggers without inspecting underlying state.
paragraphs.zh: 任务状态治理在描述性层面缩小了观察到的信心与准确率之间的差距。 在实施客观读探的漂移试验中，参与者在提交答案前报告了主观信心评分。 在对话式CUA条件下，参与者报告的平均信心为70.8%，而实际全正确准确率为45.0%，产生了+25.8个百分点的过度自信差距。 在TaskVM条件下，参与者报告的平均信心为70.4%，与之相当，但实际准确率达到57.1%，将过度自信差距缩小至+13.2个百分点。1 1 1 用于计算差距的全正确准确率排除了缺少信心评分的回答：TaskVM条件下为12/21（57.1%），基线条件下为9/20（45.0%）。 统计所有已回答的探问，TaskVM的准确率为13/22（59.1%）；TaskVM中唯一缺少信心评分的回答导致了分母的差异。 在单个探问问题上，TaskVM的准确率为84.8%（56/66），而对话式CUA在已确认的影响、有效目标和治理事实方面的准确率为73.3%（44/60）。 然而，由于漂移事件仅在部分试验中触发探问，匹配的参与者对数受到限制（n = 8 n=8，Wilcoxon p = 1.0 p=1.0，d z = + 0.10 d_{z}=+0.10）。 因此，这一探问准确率仅能作为方向性证据，而非状态理解能力经统计验证的提升；而差距的缩小也仅反映过度自信的减少，而非校准能力的真正改善。 此外，对话条件下的参与者未回答的探问数量是另一条件的两倍（6 vs 3），他们常常在探问触发后继续聊天，而未检查底层状态。

paragraphs.en: Interacting with state controls introduced an observed latency trade-off. Median intervention latency was 85.3 seconds under TaskVM compared to 65.7 seconds under Conversational CUA ( Δ = + 19.6 \Delta=+19.6 seconds in the mean paired difference, 95% t t -based CI of that mean difference [ − 9.2 -9.2 , + 48.5 +48.5 ], Wilcoxon p = .4372 p=.4372 , d z = + 0.23 d_{z}=+0.23 ). This observed difference showed substantial variation across participants (21 slower, 16 faster) and was not statistically reliable. We treat this observed pattern as an interaction trade-off rather than an established cognitive mechanism: interacting with structured state projections naturally involves reviewing visual representations before committing edits, whereas conversational chat permits immediate text dispatch.
paragraphs.zh: 与状态控制器的交互引入了一种可观察到的延迟权衡。 在 TaskVM 中，干预延迟的中位数为 85.3 秒，而在 Conversational CUA 中为 65.7 秒（Δ = +19.6 秒的平均配对差异，该平均差异的 95% t 基置信区间为 [−9.2, +48.5]，Wilcoxon p = .4372，d_z = +0.23）。 这一观察到的差异在不同参与者之间存在显著变化（21 人较慢，16 人较快），且不具备统计可靠性。 我们将这一观察到的模式视为一种交互权衡，而非已确立的认知机制：与结构化的状态投影进行交互时，自然需要先审查视觉呈现再执行编辑；而对话式聊天则允许即时发送文本。

paragraphs.en: Subjective workload on the NASA-TLX exhibited a directional reduction under TaskVM. Total workload, computed as the unweighted mean of the six dimension ratings, was lower for TaskVM (29.82 vs 39.08, Δ = − 9.26 \Delta=-9.26 , Wilcoxon p = .0938 p=.0938 , d z = − 0.36 d_{z}=-0.36 , with 21 participants reporting lower workload). All six NASA-TLX subscales showed directionally lower demand for TaskVM, with physical demand reaching statistical significance (17.97 vs 30.95, Δ = − 12.97 \Delta=-12.97 , p = .0085 p=.0085 , d z = − 0.50 d_{z}=-0.50 ) and frustration trending lower (26.49 vs 36.89, Δ = − 10.41 \Delta=-10.41 , p = .0915 p=.0915 , d z = − 0.32 d_{z}=-0.32 ). The largest perceived-control gain, the ability to stop and redirect the agent, aligns with the governance-dense zone where TaskVM’s machine-side advantage concentrated in Section 5 , suggesting that automated adjudication and human perception are sensitive to the same governance dimension. Mental demand (41.49 vs 49.73, p = .2507 p=.2507 ), temporal demand (23.24 vs 31.76, p = .1121 p=.1121 ), and effort (38.11 vs 44.46, p = .2489 p=.2489 ) remained directionally consistent. Analysis of order sequence showed no reversal of the primary pattern across order groups: participants beginning with TaskVM reported a mean workload difference of Δ ​ TLX = − 11.5 \Delta\text{TLX}=-11.5 , while those beginning with Conversational CUA reported Δ ​ TLX = − 6.9 \Delta\text{TLX}=-6.9 , with parallel directional consistency across UMUX-Lite and TIA trust scores.
paragraphs.zh: NASA-TLX 主观工作负荷在 TaskVM 条件下呈现出有方向性的降低。 总工作负荷（计算为六个维度评分的无加权平均值）在 TaskVM 条件下更低（29.82 vs 39.08，Δ = − 9.26 \Delta=-9.26，Wilcoxon p = .0938 p=.0938，d z = − 0.36 d_{z}=-0.36，其中 21 名参与者报告了更低的工作负荷）。 所有六个 NASA-TLX 子量表在 TaskVM 条件下均显示出有方向性的需求降低，其中身体需求达到了统计显著性（17.97 vs 30.95，Δ = − 12.97 \Delta=-12.97，p = .0085 p=.0085，d z = − 0.50 d_{z}=-0.50），而挫败感则呈现降低趋势（26.49 vs 36.89，Δ = − 10.41 \Delta=-10.41，p = .0915 p=.0915，d z = − 0.32 d_{z}=-0.32）。 感知控制能力最大的提升——即停止并重新引导智能体的能力——与治理密集区域相一致，TaskVM 的机器侧优势在该区域（第 5 节）最为集中，这表明自动化裁决与人类感知对同一治理维度具有敏感性。 心智需求（41.49 vs 49.73，p = .2507 p=.2507）、时间需求（23.24 vs 31.76，p = .1121 p=.1121）和努力程度（38.11 vs 44.46，p = .2489 p=.2489）在方向上保持一致。 对顺序序列的分析显示，主要模式在不同顺序组中未出现逆转：以 TaskVM 开始的参与者报告的平均工作负荷差异为 Δ ​ TLX = − 11.5 \Delta\text{TLX}=-11.5，而以对话式 CUA 开始的参与者报告的差异为 Δ ​ TLX = − 6.9 \Delta\text{TLX}=-6.9，同时 UMUX-Lite 和 TIA 信任分数也呈现出一致的方向性。

sents.en: Subjective workload on the NASA-TLX exhibited a directional reduction under TaskVM.

sents.en: Total workload, computed as the unweighted mean of the six dimension ratings, was lower for TaskVM (29.82 vs 39.08, Δ = − 9.26 \Delta=-9.26 , Wilcoxon p = .0938 p=.0938 , d z = − 0.36 d_{z}=-0.36 , with 21 participants reporting lower workload).
sents.zh: 总工作负荷（计算为六个维度评分的无加权平均值）在 TaskVM 条件下更低（29.82 vs 39.08，Δ = − 9.26 \Delta=-9.26，Wilcoxon p = .0938 p=.0938，d z = − 0.36 d_{z}=-0.36，其中 21 名参与者报告了更低的工作负荷）。

sents.en: All six NASA-TLX subscales showed directionally lower demand for TaskVM, with physical demand reaching statistical significance (17.97 vs 30.95, Δ = − 12.97 \Delta=-12.97 , p = .0085 p=.0085 , d z = − 0.50 d_{z}=-0.50 ) and frustration trending lower (26.49 vs 36.89, Δ = − 10.41 \Delta=-10.41 , p = .0915 p=.0915 , d z = − 0.32 d_{z}=-0.32 ).
sents.zh: 所有六个 NASA-TLX 子量表在 TaskVM 条件下均显示出有方向性的需求降低，其中身体需求达到了统计显著性（17.97 vs 30.95，Δ = − 12.97 \Delta=-12.97，p = .0085 p=.0085，d z = − 0.50 d_{z}=-0.50），而挫败感则呈现降低趋势（26.49 vs 36.89，Δ = − 10.41 \Delta=-10.41，p = .0915 p=.0915，d z = − 0.32 d_{z}=-0.32）。

sents.en: The largest perceived-control gain, the ability to stop and redirect the agent, aligns with the governance-dense zone where TaskVM’s machine-side advantage concentrated in Section 5 , suggesting that automated adjudication and human perception are sensitive to the same governance dimension.
sents.zh: 感知控制能力最大的提升——即停止并重新引导智能体的能力——与治理密集区域相一致，TaskVM 的机器侧优势在该区域（第 5 节）最为集中，这表明自动化裁决与人类感知对同一治理维度具有敏感性。

sents.en: Mental demand (41.49 vs 49.73, p = .2507 p=.2507 ), temporal demand (23.24 vs 31.76, p = .1121 p=.1121 ), and effort (38.11 vs 44.46, p = .2489 p=.2489 ) remained directionally consistent.

Analysis of order sequence showed no reversal of the primary pattern across order groups: participants beginning with TaskVM reported a mean workload difference of Δ ​ TLX = − 11.5 \Delta\text{TLX}=-11.5 , while those beginning with Conversational CUA reported Δ ​ TLX = − 6.9 \Delta\text{TLX}=-6.9 , with parallel directional consistency across UMUX-Lite and TIA trust scores.
sents.zh: 对顺序序列的分析显示，主要模式在不同顺序组中未出现逆转：以 TaskVM 开始的参与者报告的平均工作负荷差异为 Δ ​ TLX = − 11.5 \Delta\text{TLX}=-11.5，而以对话式 CUA 开始的参与者报告的差异为 Δ ​ TLX = − 6.9 \Delta\text{TLX}=-6.9，同时 UMUX-Lite 和 TIA 信任分数也呈现出一致的方向性。

paragraphs.en: Stage 2 held the environment and the replayed agent trajectory constant by design, which isolates perception but leaves open whether these gains persist when a live model, rather than a replay rig, executes tasks the participants themselves invent. Stage 3 (Section 7 ) examines exactly this open-ended setting.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 阶段的设计使环境和重播的智能体轨迹保持恒定，从而隔离了感知因素，但并未明确这些成果在由实时模型（而非重播系统）执行参与者自行设计的任务时是否仍然有效。 第 3 阶段（第 7 节）专门研究了这种开放式的设定。

sents.zh: 第 3 阶段（第 7 节）专门研究了这种开放式的设定。

paragraphs.en: While Stage 2 isolates perception under controlled replay, it leaves open how the governance surface is used when a live model executes tasks that users invent themselves. Stage 3 addresses this question through an exploratory follow-up in which fourteen of the 37 Stage 2 participants returned to author their own tasks and govern live-model execution through the TaskVM cockpit (Figure 5 ), with no conversational control condition. Stage 2 carries the controlled comparisons of this paper; Stage 3 characterizes use, breakdowns, and requested improvements once the scripting rails were removed.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管阶段 2 在受控重播中隔离了感知过程，但它并未阐明当实时模型执行用户自行设计的任务时，治理界面是如何被使用的。 阶段 3 通过一项探索性后续研究来解答这一问题：在 37 名阶段 2 参与者中，有 14 人返回并自行设计任务，通过 TaskVM 驾驶舱（图 5）对实时模型执行进行治理，且没有设置对话控制条件。 阶段 2 承载了本文的受控比较；而阶段 3 则在移除脚本化框架后，描述了实际使用情况、问题故障以及用户提出的改进需求。

paragraphs.en: Each returning participant issued one or more tasks of their own choosing, spanning messaging, scheduling, video browsing, and music and content applications on the same simulated application suite used in the earlier stages; per-participant usage volumes appear in Table 10 . Execution was driven by the live production model pipeline rather than a replay rig, so failures, retries, and recovery needs arose naturally. Participants interacted with the full governance surface, including live state projection, mid-flight goal edits, checkpoints, and rollback.
paragraphs.zh: 每位回归参与者都发布了一项或多项自己选择的任务，涵盖消息传递、调度、视频浏览以及音乐和内容应用，这些任务均基于早期阶段使用的同一模拟应用程序套件；每位参与者的使用量见第 10 表。 执行由实时生产模型流程驱动，而非重播环境，因此故障、重试和恢复需求自然产生。 参与者与完整的治理界面进行了交互，包括实时状态投影、运行中的目标修改、检查点以及回滚操作。

paragraphs.en: Two properties of the study environment shaped what participants could attempt, and we disclose both because they delimit the generality of the Stage 3 material. First, the substrate is a static, offline world: every searchable object exists only because it was injected during setup, so open-ended search tasks could hit coverage gaps. When a requested object was absent, strict goal binding prevented the runtime from silently substituting a near-match, and the verification layer reported the shortfall rather than fabricating success. Participants experienced this as a failed search, but it is exactly the honest-failure property the harness is designed to guarantee, and it locates the frustration in substrate coverage rather than in the governance layer. Second, for messaging tasks participants chose recipients from a designated set of fictional contacts, because the injected contact graph is finite. This constrains only the binding target. Task structure, ordering constraints, and the governance operations exercised are unaffected, and the identity of a message recipient is immaterial both to GUI execution difficulty and to the governance claims under study. After each session we collected the NASA-TLX workload instrument and two open-ended questions about the experience and desired improvements; no read or write probes were embedded.
paragraphs.zh: 研究环境的两个特性决定了参与者可以尝试的操作，我们在此揭示这两个特性，因为它们限定了第 3 阶段材料的普遍性。 首先，底层环境是一个静态的离线世界：所有可搜索的对象仅因在设置阶段被注入而存在，因此开放式的搜索任务可能会遇到覆盖范围的空缺。 当请求的对象不存在时，严格的目标绑定机制会阻止运行时静默替换一个近似匹配项，验证层则会报告这一缺失，而非捏造成功结果。 参与者将此体验为一次搜索失败，但这恰恰是该框架所设计要保障的“诚实失败”特性，它也将挫败感的根源定位在底层环境的覆盖范围上，而非治理层。 其次，在消息传递任务中，参与者从一组指定的虚拟联系人中选择接收者，因为被注入的联系人网络是有限的。 这仅对绑定目标构成限制。 任务结构、顺序约束以及所执行的治理操作不受影响，消息接收者的身份既不影响 GUI 操作的执行难度，也与本研究关注的治理主张无关。 每次会话结束后，我们收集了 NASA-TLX 工作负荷量表以及两个关于体验与期望改进的开放性问题；未嵌入任何读取或写入探针。

paragraphs.en: Invitation and compensation followed a deliberate sequence that matters for interpretation. At the end of Stage 2, participants were invited to the optional follow-up with an explicit statement that no additional compensation would be offered; this was a deliberate design choice to minimize payment-motivated self-selection. Fourteen of 37 participants returned. Post hoc, we observed that Stage 3 sessions incurred time and effort comparable to Stage 2, in some cases longer, and we therefore compensated all Stage 3 completers at the same rate (50 RMB, in addition to the 50 RMB for Stage 2). This decision was made after data collection, applied uniformly, and was not contingent on task performance, questionnaire responses, or evaluation outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 邀请和补偿遵循了一个经过深思熟虑的顺序，这对解释至关重要。 在第 2 阶段结束时，参与者被邀请参加可选的后续环节，并明确告知不会提供额外补偿；这是为了尽量减少以报酬为动机的自我选择而做出的有意设计。 在 37 名参与者中，有 14 人返回参与。 事后我们观察到，第 3 阶段的环节所需的时间和精力与第 2 阶段相当，某些情况下甚至更长，因此我们以相同的标准（50 元人民币，外加第 2 阶段的 50 元人民币）补偿了所有完成第 3 阶段的参与者。 这一决定是在数据收集之后做出的，统一适用，且并不取决于任务表现、问卷回答或评估结果。

paragraphs.en: The returning subsample was also biased toward benefit. In Stage 2, returning participants had shown a much larger workload difference between arms (TaskVM minus Conversational mean of − 24.70 -24.70 points) than non-returning participants ( + 0.14 +0.14 ), meaning that those who came back were precisely the participants who had already experienced the largest TaskVM advantage. We therefore interpret all Stage 3 outcomes descriptively: they characterize how an already-advantaged, self-selected subsample used the interface on self-authored tasks, and they do not estimate effects for the full Stage 2 population. That 14 of 37 participants returned under an explicit no-compensation promise is consistent with the interface carrying engagement value, although self-selection makes this reading tentative.
paragraphs.zh: 返回的子样本也存在偏向于收益的偏差。 在第二阶段，与未返回的参与者（+0.14）相比，返回的参与者在不同组别之间的工作量差异要大得多（TaskVM 减去对话组的均值为 −24.70 分），这意味着返回的参与者恰恰是那些已经体验到最大 TaskVM 优势的参与者。 因此，我们对第三阶段的所有结果仅作描述性解读：这些结果说明了已经具有优势且自我选择的子样本在自主撰写的任务中如何使用该界面，但它们并未估计第二阶段全部参与者的效应。 在明确承诺无补偿的情况下，仍有 37 名参与者中的 14 人返回，这表明该界面具有一定的吸引力，但自我选择机制使这一解读尚需谨慎对待。

paragraphs.en: Stage 3 workload ratings were lower than the same participants’ earlier ratings, and we report this pattern strictly descriptively. Table 5 pairs each participant’s Stage 3 NASA-TLX total with their own Stage 2 scores. Stage 3 workload averaged 15.5 on the 0 to 100 scale, against 25.2 for the same participants in their Stage 2 TaskVM arm (mean Δ = − 9.70 \Delta=-9.70 , d z = − 0.83 d_{z}=-0.83 , Wilcoxon p = .011 p=.011 , with 12 of 14 participants lower) and 49.9 in their Stage 2 Conversational arm (mean Δ = − 34.40 \Delta=-34.40 , d z = − 1.43 d_{z}=-1.43 , p < .001 p<.001 , with all 14 lower). Because task selection, practice, study procedures, and execution mode all changed together between stages, these differences cannot be attributed to any single factor, and we do not treat them as evidence of workload reduction. We report them as low observed workload in these particular sessions, not as evidence about the governance surface’s cost in general. The two participants whose workload rose (P20, P02) attributed it to a model-side execution loop on a complex task and to friction in starting successive tasks, respectively; neither attributed it to governance mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 第 3 阶段的工作负荷评分低于同一参与者在早期阶段的评分，我们仅以描述性方式报告这一模式。 表 5 将每位参与者在第 3 阶段的 NASA-TLX 总分与其在第 2 阶段的得分进行对比。 第 3 阶段的工作负荷在 0 到 100 的量表上平均为 15.5，而同一参与者在第 2 阶段 TaskVM 分支中的平均值为 25.2（均值差异 Δ = −9.70 \Delta=-9.70，效应量 d_z = −0.83 d_{z}=-0.83，Wilcoxon p = .011 p=.011，其中 14 名参与者中有 12 人的评分更低），在 Conversational 分支中则为 49.9（均值差异 Δ = −34.40 \Delta=-34.40，效应量 d_z = −1.43 d_{z}=-1.43，p < .001 p<.001，14 人全部更低）。 由于任务选择、练习、研究流程和执行模式在阶段之间均同时发生了变化，这些差异无法归因于任何单一因素，我们也不将其视为工作负荷降低的证据。 我们仅将这些结果报告为在这些特定会话中观察到的较低工作负荷，而非关于治理机制成本的一般性证据。 工作负荷上升的两名参与者（P20、P02）分别将其归因于复杂任务中模型侧的执行循环，以及连续任务启动时的摩擦；两人均未将其归因于治理机制。

sents.zh: 第 3 阶段的工作负荷在 0 到 100 的量表上平均为 15.5，而同一参与者在第 2 阶段 TaskVM 分支中的平均值为 25.2（均值差异 Δ = −9.70 \Delta=-9.70，效应量 d_z = −0.83 d_{z}=-0.83，Wilcoxon p = .011 p=.011，其中 14 名参与者中有 12 人的评分更低），在 Conversational 分支中则为 49.9（均值差异 Δ = −34.40 \Delta=-34.40，效应量 d_z = −1.43 d_{z}=-1.43，p < .001 p<.001，14 人全部更低）。

sents.en: Because task selection, practice, study procedures, and execution mode all changed together between stages, these differences cannot be attributed to any single factor, and we do not treat them as evidence of workload reduction.
sents.zh: 由于任务选择、练习、研究流程和执行模式在阶段之间均同时发生了变化，这些差异无法归因于任何单一因素，我们也不将其视为工作负荷降低的证据。

sents.en: We report them as low observed workload in these particular sessions, not as evidence about the governance surface’s cost in general.
sents.zh: 我们仅将这些结果报告为在这些特定会话中观察到的较低工作负荷，而非关于治理机制成本的一般性证据。

sents.en: The two participants whose workload rose (P20, P02) attributed it to a model-side execution loop on a complex task and to friction in starting successive tasks, respectively; neither attributed it to governance mechanisms.
sents.zh: 工作负荷上升的两名参与者（P20、P02）分别将其归因于复杂任务中模型侧的执行循环，以及连续任务启动时的摩擦；两人均未将其归因于治理机制。

paragraphs.en: The qualitative material consists of responses to two open-ended questions, not interviews. We grouped responses into themes, with the individual response as the coding unit; a single participant could contribute to more than one theme, and theme counts below refer to distinct participants.
paragraphs.zh: 定性材料由对两个开放式问题的回答组成，而非访谈。 我们将回答按主题进行分组，以单个回答为编码单位；同一参与者可能为多个主题提供内容，下文提到的主题数量均指不同的参与者。

sents.en: We grouped responses into themes, with the individual response as the coding unit; a single participant could contribute to more than one theme, and theme counts below refer to distinct participants.

paragraphs.en: On the supportive side, four participants (P21, P37, P27, P25) described faithful execution and precise intent recognition under open-ended tasks. P27 wrote that the system recognized the intended edit and completed the keyword changes without over-guessing what they wanted to do [translated], and P21 described watching the planned decomposition land step by step as reassuring [translated]. One participant’s account constitutes logged governance use: P30 inserted a new instruction midway through execution, asking the agent to additionally ask a specific colleague about overtime availability, and reported that the agent completed the original task and then correctly located the colleague and delivered the inquiry, describing the outcome as deeply satisfying [translated]; this insertion also appears in the session record, so it reflects logged use rather than praise alone. Separately, P35 praised the topology view of task structure as something they really liked [translated]; we count this as appreciation of the interface, not as use of a governance operation. Two participants (P30, P27) independently requested stronger governance automation, asking that the system place checkpoints automatically at nodes where failures are likely [translated]. We read these requests as demand-side evidence that the checkpoint concept had been absorbed and extended by users, not as reports of a system defect.
paragraphs.zh: 在支持性方面，四名参与者（P21、P37、P27、P25）描述了系统在开放式任务中能够忠实地执行指令并精准识别意图。 P27写道，系统识别了预期的编辑操作，并完成了关键词的更改，而没有过度猜测他们的需求[已翻译]；P21则描述道，看到计划的分步执行逐步落实令人安心[已翻译]。 一名参与者的叙述构成了有记录的管理使用案例：P30在执行过程中途插入了一条新指令，要求智能体额外向一位特定同事询问加班可行性，并报告称智能体在完成原始任务后，正确地找到了该同事并传达了询问内容，他对此结果表示深感满意[已翻译]；这一插入操作也出现在会话记录中，因此反映了有记录的使用行为，而不仅仅是单纯的称赞。 此外，P35对任务结构的拓扑视图表示赞赏，称他们非常喜欢这种设计[已翻译]；我们将其视为对界面的认可，而非对管理操作的实际使用。 两名参与者（P30、P27）独立地提出了加强管理自动化的需求，希望系统能够在可能发生故障的节点上自动设置检查点[已翻译]。 我们将这些请求解读为需求端的证据，表明用户已经吸收并扩展了检查点的概念，而非系统缺陷的报告。

paragraphs.en: On the critical side, three themes emerged, ordered by severity. First, three participants (P35, P06, P13) were frustrated when open-ended search queries missed the simulated platform’s injected data. One searched for several popular videos and found none of them [translated]; another searched for their own uploaded videos and felt discouraged when nothing came back [translated]. This reflects the finite data coverage of the static offline substrate (Section 7 ), not the governance mechanism: in each case the system reported the miss honestly instead of substituting a plausible-looking result, and it is the most visible limitation of the study environment. Second, four participants (P10, P20, P13, P22) traced failures to live-model execution problems such as retry loops, repeated actions, and lost task continuation. These failures originate in the executor (model) layer and would be inherited by any interface paradigm; what differs across interfaces is how such failures are surfaced, contained, and recovered from, which is precisely where the governance features are exercised. We therefore report them as executor-side occurrences with interface-side consequences, without claiming that the governance layer is unaffected by them. Third, seven participants reported one-iteration usability issues such as progress visibility during retries, state-clearing feedback, and onboarding gaps, and two of them asked for features that already existed but had not been covered in the tutorial.
paragraphs.zh: 从关键问题层面来看，有三个主题浮现出来，按严重程度依次排列。 首先，有三名参与者（P35、P06、P13）因开放式搜索查询未能检索到模拟平台注入的数据而感到沮丧。 其中一人搜索了多个热门视频，但一个也找不到[已翻译]；另一人搜索自己上传的视频，却因毫无结果而感到气馁[已翻译]。 这反映的是静态离线基础架构（第 7 节）的数据覆盖范围有限，而非治理机制的问题：在每种情况下，系统都诚实地报告了未检索到的结果，而不是替换为一个看似合理的结果，这也是研究环境中最明显的局限性。 其次，有四名参与者（P10、P20、P13、P22）将失败归因于实时模型执行问题，例如重试循环、重复操作和任务中断。 这些失败源于执行器（模型）层，任何接口范式都会继承这些问题；不同接口之间的差异在于如何呈现、控制并恢复此类失败，而这正是治理功能发挥作用的关键环节。 因此，我们将这些问题报告为执行器侧的事件及其在接口侧引发的后果，但并未声称治理层不受其影响。 第三，有七名参与者报告了单次迭代中的可用性相关问题，例如重试过程中的进度可见性、状态清除反馈以及引导流程的缺失；其中两人还提出了一些教程中未提及但实际已存在的功能需求。

paragraphs.en: Across all open-ended responses, no participant spontaneously reported difficulty understanding the state of the underlying applications or losing control of the running task; every negative remark concerned substrate data coverage, executor performance, or interface polish.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有开放式回答中，没有参与者自发报告过难以理解底层应用程序的状态或失去对正在运行的任务的控制；所有负面评论都涉及基础数据覆盖、执行器性能或接口优化问题。

paragraphs.en: A central objective of TaskVM is substrate independence: ensuring that task-state governance operates across diverse software stacks without requiring application-specific programming interfaces. As mapped in the substrate port of Figure 3 , TaskVM abstracts external software through a unified port interface that renders pixels into observations and dispatches standard hardware inputs, and we maintain adapters for modern single-page web applications, mobile environments hosted through MobileGym ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , and Linux desktop applications within OSWorld ( Xie et al., 2024 ) . Across these environments, the runtime compiles the same state-level intents into substrate-specific gestures, and the independent visual verifier confirms terminal states from raw screen pixels, so a unified task contract survives platform changes.
paragraphs.zh: TaskVM 的核心目标之一是底层平台无关性：确保任务状态治理能够在多样化的软件栈中运行，而无需依赖特定应用程序的编程接口。 如图 3 的底层平台端口所示，TaskVM 通过统一的端口接口对外部软件进行抽象：该接口将像素转换为观察数据，并发送标准的硬件输入；我们为现代单页网页应用、通过 MobileGym（Wu et al., 2026）托管的移动环境以及 OSWorld（Xie et al., 2024）中的 Linux 桌面应用提供了适配器。 在这些环境中，运行时将相同的状态级意图编译为特定于底层平台的操作指令，而独立的视觉验证器则从原始屏幕像素中确认终端状态，从而确保统一的任务契约在平台变更时依然有效。

paragraphs.en: Our cross-substrate investigations also expose clear operational boundaries where the abstraction encounters friction:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的跨基板研究也揭示了明确的运行边界，在这些边界上，抽象化会遇到摩擦：

paragraphs.en: Canvas-Rendered Interfaces: Applications rendered entirely through low-level graphical canvases lack discrete visual text and standard widget affordances, challenging the visual entity extraction pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 画布渲染界面：完全通过底层图形画布渲染的应用程序缺乏独立的视觉文本和标准小部件交互元素，给视觉实体提取流程带来了挑战。

paragraphs.en: Transient Dynamic Popups: Short-lived visual notifications that appear and fade within sub-second intervals can elude periodic screenshot polling, occasionally delaying conflict detection.
paragraphs.zh: 瞬态动态弹出窗口：在亚秒级时间间隔内出现并消失的短暂视觉通知，可能逃避周期性截图轮询，偶尔会延迟冲突检测。

paragraphs.en: Defensive Anti-Automation Gates: Web platforms deploying CAPTCHA challenges, biometric verification, or aggressive bot-detection scripts intentionally resist automated inputs, representing an absolute boundary requiring direct human handoff.
paragraphs.zh: 防御性反自动化网关：部署 CAPTCHA 挑战、生物特征验证或激进式机器人检测脚本的网络平台，会故意抵抗自动化输入，这构成了一道绝对边界，需要直接由人类介入处理。

paragraphs.en: Desktop Window Occlusion: Overlapping application windows on multi-tasking desktops can temporarily obscure visual evidence, requiring the runtime to synthesize window-focus management gestures before polling visual artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 桌面窗口遮挡：在多任务桌面上，重叠的应用程序窗口可能会暂时遮挡视觉证据，因此运行时环境需要在轮询视觉元素之前合成窗口焦点管理手势。

paragraphs.en: Documenting these boundaries clarifies that task-state governance is designed for structured productivity workflows, establishing transparent expectations for open-world deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 记录这些边界可以明确一点：任务状态治理是为结构化生产力工作流程而设计的，从而为开放世界部署建立了透明的期望。

paragraphs.en: The core question raised by TaskVM is not merely how agents execute software, but how users interact with, verify, and recover from software state changes with bounded cognitive effort. Here we discuss four critical interaction design choices emerging from the TaskVM paradigm, its technical evaluations, and its associated operational costs.
paragraphs.zh: TaskVM 提出的核心问题不仅在于智能体如何执行软件，更在于用户如何以有限的认知努力与软件进行交互、验证其状态变化，并在状态变化后恢复。 在此，我们将探讨从 TaskVM 范式衍生出的四项关键交互设计选择，以及相关的技术评估和运营成本。

sents.en: The core question raised by TaskVM is not merely how agents execute software, but how users interact with, verify, and recover from software state changes with bounded cognitive effort.
sents.zh: TaskVM 提出的核心问题不仅在于智能体如何执行软件，更在于用户如何以有限的认知努力与软件进行交互、验证其状态变化，并在状态变化后恢复。

sents.en: Here we discuss four critical interaction design choices emerging from the TaskVM paradigm, its technical evaluations, and its associated operational costs.
sents.zh: 在此，我们将探讨从 TaskVM 范式衍生出的四项关键交互设计选择，以及相关的技术评估和运营成本。

paragraphs.en: In traditional conversational agents, users are placed in an unnatural supervisory role: watching an automated cursor move across windows and reading lengthy logs to verify execution. This introduces passive monitoring costs and opportunities for automation bias ( Bainbridge, 1983 ; Parasuraman and Manzey, 2010 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在传统对话智能体中，用户被置于一种不自然的监督角色：观察自动光标在窗口间移动，并阅读冗长的日志以验证执行过程。 这带来了被动监控的成本，也助长了自动化偏见（Bainbridge, 1983；Parasuraman and Manzey, 2010）。

sents.en: In traditional conversational agents, users are placed in an unnatural supervisory role: watching an automated cursor move across windows and reading lengthy logs to verify execution.
sents.zh: 在传统对话智能体中，用户被置于一种不自然的监督角色：观察自动光标在窗口间移动，并阅读冗长的日志以验证执行过程。

sents.en: This introduces passive monitoring costs and opportunities for automation bias ( Bainbridge, 1983 ; Parasuraman and Manzey, 2010 ) .
sents.zh: 这带来了被动监控的成本，也助长了自动化偏见（Bainbridge, 1983；Parasuraman and Manzey, 2010）。

paragraphs.en: TaskVM replaces this monitoring with explicit contract definition. The user specifies both a desired state and a preservation scope, effectively transferring the effort from watching cursor clicks to writing state constraints. While this shifts human attention from procedural navigation to declarative intent, it does not entirely remove cognitive effort. Determining which fields may change and which must remain protected is its own conceptual workload. We argue that when dealing with multi-application environments, defining bounded state invariants is more tractable than mentally synthesizing low-level execution traces across isolated application silos.
paragraphs.zh: TaskVM 用明确的合同定义取代了这种监控方式。 用户既指定了期望状态，也规定了保留范围，从而将注意力从观察光标点击转移到了编写状态约束上。 虽然这种方式将人类的注意力从流程式导航转向了声明式意图，但并未完全消除认知负担。 确定哪些字段可以更改、哪些必须保持受保护，本身就需要一定的概念性工作量。 我们认为，在处理多应用环境时，定义有界的状态不变量比在孤立的应用程序孤岛之间 mentally 合成低层执行轨迹更为可行。

sents.en: TaskVM replaces this monitoring with explicit contract definition.
sents.zh: TaskVM 用明确的合同定义取代了这种监控方式。

sents.en: The user specifies both a desired state and a preservation scope, effectively transferring the effort from watching cursor clicks to writing state constraints.
sents.zh: 用户既指定了期望状态，也规定了保留范围，从而将注意力从观察光标点击转移到了编写状态约束上。

sents.en: While this shifts human attention from procedural navigation to declarative intent, it does not entirely remove cognitive effort.
sents.zh: 虽然这种方式将人类的注意力从流程式导航转向了声明式意图，但并未完全消除认知负担。

sents.en: Determining which fields may change and which must remain protected is its own conceptual workload.
sents.zh: 确定哪些字段可以更改、哪些必须保持受保护，本身就需要一定的概念性工作量。

sents.en: We argue that when dealing with multi-application environments, defining bounded state invariants is more tractable than mentally synthesizing low-level execution traces across isolated application silos.
sents.zh: 我们认为，在处理多应用环境时，定义有界的状态不变量比在孤立的应用程序孤岛之间 mentally 合成低层执行轨迹更为可行。

paragraphs.en: The properties provided by TaskVM do not come without overhead. In conventional computer-use agents, execution progresses through an unconstrained forward loop, generating actions until the model emits a stop token. TaskVM, by contrast, introduces structured overhead at multiple stages: compiling initial state, projecting the interface through a secondary model, filtering internal identifiers, and polling rendered screens.
paragraphs.zh: TaskVM 提供的特性并非没有额外开销。 在传统计算机使用智能体中，执行过程通过一个无约束的前向循环推进，持续生成动作，直到模型发出停止标记。 相比之下，TaskVM 在多个阶段引入了结构化的额外开销：编译初始状态、通过次级模型投影接口、过滤内部标识符以及轮询渲染后的屏幕。

sents.en: The properties provided by TaskVM do not come without overhead.
sents.zh: TaskVM 提供的特性并非没有额外开销。

sents.en: In conventional computer-use agents, execution progresses through an unconstrained forward loop, generating actions until the model emits a stop token.
sents.zh: 在传统计算机使用智能体中，执行过程通过一个无约束的前向循环推进，持续生成动作，直到模型发出停止标记。

sents.en: TaskVM, by contrast, introduces structured overhead at multiple stages: compiling initial state, projecting the interface through a secondary model, filtering internal identifiers, and polling rendered screens.
sents.zh: 相比之下，TaskVM 在多个阶段引入了结构化的额外开销：编译初始状态、通过次级模型投影接口、过滤内部标识符以及轮询渲染后的屏幕。

paragraphs.en: Our automated benchmarks highlight this trade-off. TaskVM consumed 19,960 seconds of total wall time and 1,126 model calls across 36 task trials, compared to 9,010 seconds / 1,361 calls for Direct-CUA, and 6,695 seconds / 1,031 calls for Planner-CUA (Table 1 ). This cost distribution cannot be attributed solely to verification: state compilation, dynamic re-projection, and structured execution boundaries all contribute to the measured wall-time gap. However, if an interface treats an external task merely as an asynchronous background job, the cost of an unverified error in high-stakes enterprise software vastly outweighs the latency of checking. An observed trade-off also emerged in our user study: participants exhibited a median intervention latency 19.6 seconds higher under TaskVM (Table 4 ), a pattern characterized by substantial variance across users without a statistically reliable condition effect. Neither of our human studies decomposes this runtime overhead into machine and human shares. The replay study estimates interaction latency in a controlled setting and cannot establish whether verification delays surface for users under live execution; the exploratory follow-up offers workload descriptions rather than a controlled cost comparison. A design implication is therefore to make verification effort and its products visible at the points where users must judge or intervene, while explicitly evaluating how evidence presentation, waiting time, and recovery demands interact under live execution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的自动化基准测试凸显了这一权衡。 在 36 次任务试验中，TaskVM 的总实际运行时间为 19,960 秒，模型调用次数为 1,126 次；相比之下，Direct-CUA 的实际运行时间为 9,010 秒，模型调用次数为 1,361 次，而 Planner-CUA 的实际运行时间为 6,695 秒，模型调用次数为 1,031 次（表 1）。 这种成本分布不能仅归因于验证：状态编译、动态重投影和结构化执行边界都导致了所测得的实际运行时间差异。 然而，如果某个接口将外部任务仅仅视为一个异步后台任务，那么在高风险企业软件中，未验证错误所带来的成本将远远超过验证所产生的延迟。 在我们的用户研究中还观察到了另一种权衡：在 TaskVM 环境下，参与者的平均干预延迟高出 19.6 秒（表 4）；这一模式的特点是不同用户之间的差异显著，且条件效应不具备统计显著性。 我们的人机研究均未将这一运行时开销分解为机器和人类各自承担的部分。 重播研究在受控环境中估算了交互延迟，但无法确定验证延迟是否在实时执行中实际影响用户；而探索性后续研究提供了工作负载描述，而非受控的成本比较。 因此，一个设计上的启示是：在用户必须做出判断或进行干预的关键节点上，应使验证过程及其成果清晰可见，同时明确评估证据呈现、等待时间和恢复需求在实时执行中的相互作用。

paragraphs.en: A recurring theme in TaskVM is that interfaces cannot simply trust self-reported execution successes. We rely on independent visual verification against observable fields to certify task state. However, this relies on an important boundary: visible observations can prove what is rendered on the display, but they cannot strictly prove hidden backend states or atomic transactional assurances across third-party platforms.
paragraphs.zh: TaskVM 中一个反复出现的主题是：接口不能仅仅依赖智能体自行报告的执行成功信息。 我们依靠对可观察字段的独立视觉验证来确认任务状态。 然而，这依赖于一个重要的界限：可见的观察结果可以证明显示内容，但无法严格证明隐藏的后台状态或跨第三方平台的原子事务保障。

sents.en: A recurring theme in TaskVM is that interfaces cannot simply trust self-reported execution successes.
sents.zh: TaskVM 中一个反复出现的主题是：接口不能仅仅依赖智能体自行报告的执行成功信息。

sents.en: We rely on independent visual verification against observable fields to certify task state.
sents.zh: 我们依靠对可观察字段的独立视觉验证来确认任务状态。

sents.en: However, this relies on an important boundary: visible observations can prove what is rendered on the display, but they cannot strictly prove hidden backend states or atomic transactional assurances across third-party platforms.
sents.zh: 然而，这依赖于一个重要的界限：可见的观察结果可以证明显示内容，但无法严格证明隐藏的后台状态或跨第三方平台的原子事务保障。

paragraphs.en: For example, a verified booking screen shows that the UI reflects a date change, but does not inherently prove that airline system databases successfully processed a refund or cancellation ticket. TaskVM’s live state projection surfaces exactly what the system can observe, flagging when visual evidence is insufficient rather than silently assuming consistency. This transparency highlights that interface trust should be grounded in explicit model boundaries, not in exaggerated claims of system-wide correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，一个经过验证的预订界面显示，用户界面反映了日期的变更，但这本身并不能证明航空公司的系统数据库已成功处理退款或取消机票。 TaskVM 的实时状态投影精确展示了系统能够观察到的内容，并在视觉证据不足时进行标记，而不是默认为系统一致。 这种透明度凸显了这样一个事实：对界面的信任应基于明确的模型边界，而非对系统整体正确性的夸大宣称。

paragraphs.en: A prevalent tendency in automated agent design is the masking of failures through optimistic self-reporting. When an agent makes an irreversible error, such as deleting a contact record, conversational interfaces often provide vague reassurances, misleading users into believing the action can be undone. TaskVM implements a tripartite taxonomy of reversibility. Reversible and compensatable actions are tracked and counteracted through inverse GUI gestures, while irreversible operations are explicitly locked to prevent deceptive undo representations. Empirically, participants exercised goal interventions in every task by design, and 11 of 37 additionally invoked rollback a total of 17 times under TaskVM (baseline: 2 participants, 4 times), with 13 of those 17 events occurring outside the two tasks that scripted an undo request, demonstrating that participants reached for the exposed recovery control even when not asked to.
paragraphs.zh: 在自动化智能体设计中，一种普遍倾向是通过乐观的自我报告来掩盖故障。 当智能体犯下不可逆的错误时（例如删除联系人记录），对话界面通常会给出模糊的安慰性提示，误导用户认为该操作可以撤销。 TaskVM 实施了一种三分的可逆性分类体系。 可逆且可补偿的操作通过反向 GUI 手势进行追踪和抵消，而不可逆操作则被明确锁定，以防止出现具有欺骗性的撤销提示。 从经验上看，参与者根据设计在每一项任务中都执行了目标干预；在 TaskVM 环境下，37 名参与者中有 11 人额外触发了 17 次回滚（基线情况为：2 名参与者，4 次），其中 17 次事件中的 13 次发生在未脚本化撤销请求的两项任务之外，这表明即使未被要求，参与者也会主动使用暴露的恢复控制。

paragraphs.en: We note that compensating actions, such as sending a cancellation message, do not equate to true atomic rollbacks. They introduce secondary effects and may leave behind specific audit trails in third-party systems. By forcing the interface to distinguish between these recovery modes, TaskVM shifts user trust away from fictional comprehensive undo capabilities toward calibrated expectations about what can, and cannot, be reversed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们注意到，诸如发送取消消息之类的补偿操作并不等同于真正的原子回滚。 这些操作会引发次级影响，并可能在第三方系统中留下特定的审计痕迹。 通过强制接口区分这些恢复模式，TaskVM将用户的信任从虚构的全面撤销能力转向对哪些内容可以或无法被撤销的校准预期。

paragraphs.en: Our evidence also reveals a productive tension: rollback is simultaneously the most demanded governance capability and the hardest to make reliable. Rollback was the operation our baselines lacked entirely, the function 11 of 37 study participants invoked (17 events) beyond scripted requests, and the automation Stage 3 participants requested in stronger form, asking for checkpoints placed automatically at failure-prone nodes. Yet the one unresolved failure in our stress tier is precisely a rollback-compensation family, blocked by a race between a signing window and the confirmation gesture. We read this convergence not as a defect to be excused but as the clearest roadmap the paradigm offers: honest vocabulary about recovery creates demand for reliable recovery, and the engineering agenda should follow the demand.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的证据还揭示了一种富有成效的张力：回滚既是需求最迫切的治理能力，也是最难以实现可靠性的能力。 回滚是我们基准模型完全缺乏的操作，是 37 名研究参与者中 11 人（涉及 17 个事件）在脚本化请求之外调用的功能，也是自动化阶段 3 的参与者以更强烈的形式提出的需求，他们要求系统在易发生故障的节点上自动设置检查点。 然而，我们压力测试层级中唯一未解决的故障恰恰属于回滚补偿类问题，其根源在于签名窗口与确认手势之间的竞争。 我们将这种趋同现象解读为一条清晰的路线图，而非需要辩解的缺陷：关于恢复机制的坦诚讨论催生了对可靠恢复的需求，而工程议程应当紧随这一需求展开。

paragraphs.en: Our results are bounded in several ways. Stage 2 holds the environment and the replayed agent trajectory constant, which isolates perception but cannot evidence live-model execution success or real recovery capability; its read probes reached only a subset of trials ( n = 8 n=8 matched pairs), so probe accuracy is directional evidence rather than an established gain in understanding. Stage 3 restores a live model and participant-authored tasks but removes the control arm, so its lower workload is descriptive and confounded with task freedom and practice, and its sample is self-selected: the 14 returning participants had shown a substantially larger Stage 2 workload advantage than the 23 who did not return ( − 24.70 -24.70 versus + 0.14 +0.14 NASA-TLX points). Participants were recruited from a single laboratory research-volunteer pool skewing toward university students and researchers. All stages ran on an offline simulated application suite with finite injected data, so open-ended search occasionally missed the corpus, adding noise without affecting the governance mechanism; cross-platform deployment is engineering-supported through our substrate adapters but not empirically demonstrated here; live-model execution failures such as retry loops originate in the executor layer, yet their consequences still require an interface that can surface and govern them. On the system side, our compiled schemas express structured productivity workflows whose state maps to discrete variables and invariant predicates; continuous creative workflows (video editing, 3D modeling, freehand illustration) resist this decomposition, and our purely visual polling can miss sub-second transient UI states, complicating fine-grained causal diagnosis. Finally, TaskVM deliberately does not circumvent defensive gates such as CAPTCHAs; graceful human handoff at such boundaries, broader and more diverse samples, production substrates, and equivalence-controlled live-model comparisons are the natural next steps.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的结果在多个方面都存在局限性。 阶段 2 保持环境和重播的智能体轨迹不变，从而隔离了感知过程，但无法证明实时模型执行的成功或真正的恢复能力；其读取探针仅覆盖了部分试验（n = 8 个匹配对），因此探针准确性只是方向性证据，而非理解能力的明确提升。 阶段 3 恢复了实时模型和由参与者创建的任务，但移除了对照组，因此其较低的工作负荷仅具有描述性，并与任务自由度和练习效果存在混淆；此外，其样本是自选择的：14 名回归参与者与未回归的 23 人相比，在阶段 2 中表现出明显更大的工作负荷优势（NASA-TLX 分数为 −24.70 对比 +0.14）。 参与者来自单一实验室的研究志愿者群体，该群体以大学生和研究人员为主。 所有阶段均在离线模拟的应用程序套件上运行，且注入的数据有限，因此开放式搜索偶尔会遗漏语料库，从而引入噪声但未影响治理机制；跨平台部署通过我们的底层适配器得到了工程支持，但在此并未得到实证验证；实时模型执行失败（如重试循环）源于执行器层，但其后果仍需要一个能够暴露并管理这些问题的接口。 在系统层面，我们编译的模式表达了结构化的生产力工作流程，其状态可映射到离散变量和不变谓词；而连续的创造性工作流程（视频编辑、3D 建模、自由手绘）则难以进行这种分解，并且我们纯粹的视觉轮询可能遗漏亚秒级的瞬时 UI 状态，从而增加了精细因果诊断的复杂性。 最后，TaskVM 有意不绕过 CAPTCHA 等防御机制；在这些边界处实现优雅的人类接管、采用更广泛和多样化的样本、使用生产级底层系统以及进行等效控制的实时模型对比，是自然的后续步骤。

sents.en: Our results are bounded in several ways.
sents.zh: 我们的结果在多个方面都存在局限性。

sents.en: Stage 2 holds the environment and the replayed agent trajectory constant, which isolates perception but cannot evidence live-model execution success or real recovery capability; its read probes reached only a subset of trials ( n = 8 n=8 matched pairs), so probe accuracy is directional evidence rather than an established gain in understanding.
sents.zh: 阶段 2 保持环境和重播的智能体轨迹不变，从而隔离了感知过程，但无法证明实时模型执行的成功或真正的恢复能力；其读取探针仅覆盖了部分试验（n = 8 个匹配对），因此探针准确性只是方向性证据，而非理解能力的明确提升。

sents.en: Stage 3 restores a live model and participant-authored tasks but removes the control arm, so its lower workload is descriptive and confounded with task freedom and practice, and its sample is self-selected: the 14 returning participants had shown a substantially larger Stage 2 workload advantage than the 23 who did not return ( − 24.70 -24.70 versus + 0.14 +0.14 NASA-TLX points).
sents.zh: 阶段 3 恢复了实时模型和由参与者创建的任务，但移除了对照组，因此其较低的工作负荷仅具有描述性，并与任务自由度和练习效果存在混淆；此外，其样本是自选择的：14 名回归参与者与未回归的 23 人相比，在阶段 2 中表现出明显更大的工作负荷优势（NASA-TLX 分数为 −24.70 对比 +0.14）。

sents.en: Participants were recruited from a single laboratory research-volunteer pool skewing toward university students and researchers.

sents.en: All stages ran on an offline simulated application suite with finite injected data, so open-ended search occasionally missed the corpus, adding noise without affecting the governance mechanism; cross-platform deployment is engineering-supported through our substrate adapters but not empirically demonstrated here; live-model execution failures such as retry loops originate in the executor layer, yet their consequences still require an interface that can surface and govern them.

paragraphs.en: As autonomous agents gain the ability to execute complex workflows, the object users must govern is not the agent’s procedure but the state of the world the agent touches. We present task-state governance, an interaction model that frames a cross-application task as an editable relationship among desired outcomes, protected facts, and observed application state. TaskVM instantiates this relationship through task-level controls, separately checked observations, and explicitly bounded recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 随着自主智能体获得执行复杂工作流程的能力，用户必须管理的对象不再是智能体的流程，而是智能体所影响的世界状态。 我们提出了任务状态治理，这是一种交互模型，它将跨应用任务定义为期望结果、受保护事实和已观察到的应用状态之间的可编辑关系。 TaskVM 通过任务级控制、独立检查的观察结果以及明确限定的恢复机制来实现这种关系。

sents.en: As autonomous agents gain the ability to execute complex workflows, the object users must govern is not the agent’s procedure but the state of the world the agent touches.
sents.zh: 随着自主智能体获得执行复杂工作流程的能力，用户必须管理的对象不再是智能体的流程，而是智能体所影响的世界状态。

sents.en: TaskVM instantiates this relationship through task-level controls, separately checked observations, and explicitly bounded recovery.
sents.zh: TaskVM 通过任务级控制、独立检查的观察结果以及明确限定的恢复机制来实现这种关系。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation characterizes three distinct questions with three distinct designs: technical capability and cost on a fixed benchmark suite, subjective experience under controlled replay, and exploratory use by returning participants on self-authored tasks. These are complementary forms of evidence rather than three confirmations of one mechanism, and each carries the boundaries registered in the preceding section. Together they show that the obligations and limits of agent-mediated change can be made explicit objects of interaction, verifiable in principle and inspectable in use, while live-execution effectiveness and broader generalization remain open to further study. By shifting the unit of interaction from procedural plans to verifiable state contracts, TaskVM suggests how users can govern autonomous agents with clarity and calibrated trust: humans govern tasks, while agents operate applications.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估针对三个不同的问题，采用了三种不同的设计：在固定基准套件上测试技术能力与成本、在受控重播下评估主观体验，以及让回归参与者自行创作任务并进行探索性使用。 这些是相互补充的证据形式，而非对同一机制的三次确认，且每种证据都带有前一小节中已明确界定的边界。 综合来看，它们表明由智能体中介的变革所涉及的义务与限制，可以成为明确的互动对象——原则上可验证、实际使用中可检验；而实时执行的有效性和更广泛的泛化能力，仍有待进一步研究。 通过将互动单位从程序性计划转向可验证的状态契约，TaskVM 提出了一种方法：用户如何以清晰且经过校准的信任来管理自主智能体——人类负责管理任务，而智能体则负责运行应用。

paragraphs.en: This appendix defines the ten Contract-Outcome Verification (COV) predicates used to adjudicate every Stage 1 trial. Each trial is scored on every applicable predicate; a strict pass requires all applicable predicates to pass.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录定义了用于裁决每个第一阶段试验的十个“合同结果验证”（COV）谓词。 每次试验都会根据所有适用的谓词进行评分；要严格通过，则所有适用谓词都必须通过。

sents.en: This appendix defines the ten Contract-Outcome Verification (COV) predicates used to adjudicate every Stage 1 trial.
sents.zh: 本附录定义了用于裁决每个第一阶段试验的十个“合同结果验证”（COV）谓词。

paragraphs.en: We document the exclusion and correction decisions behind the Stage 1 numbers so the reported tables can be audited cell by cell.
paragraphs.zh: 我们记录了第一阶段数据背后的排除和修正决策，以便对已报告的表格进行逐单元格审计。

paragraphs.en: Five trials in the first wave failed at the infrastructure level rather than at task execution (two vendor server errors and three setup timeouts); these were re-run cleanly, and their invalidated records were removed from all denominators. Two further trials misclassified by the fail-loud grading gate (one true pass and one valid failure) were vindicated in a subsequent envelope audit and counted correctly. Frozen pass verdicts are regression-locked and can never be reversed by later waves. In the skills-ON wave, TaskVM has valid cells for 23 of 36 instances; the remaining cells are recorded as missing rather than scored as failures, and a cell-level index cross-validation across all 108 cells reported zero mismatches.
paragraphs.zh: 第一波测试中有五次尝试因基础设施问题而非任务执行失败（两次供应商服务器错误和三次设置超时）；这些测试已顺利重新运行，其无效记录已从所有分母中移除。 另外两次被“fail-loud”评分机制误判的测试（一次实际通过和一次有效失败），在随后的信封审计中得到证实，并得到了正确计数。 已冻结的通过判定结果受回归锁定，后续任何波次都无法更改。 在 skills-ON 波次中，TaskVM 在 36 个实例中有 23 个有效单元格；其余单元格被记录为缺失而非评分为失败，且对所有 108 个单元格的单元格级索引交叉验证报告了零处不匹配。

paragraphs.en: Finally, the non-inferiority analysis reported in Table 3 is the corrected protocol version computed after adjudication of the frozen waves. An earlier draft compared the skills-ON and skills-OFF waves against each other and was inconclusive; the corrected analysis follows the evaluation protocol in comparing TaskVM against its strongest baseline within a single wave on contract-faithful execution, pairing 35 task clusters and resampling 10,000 times with a fixed seed. At the 10 percentage-point margin specified in our evaluation protocol the one-sided 95 percent lower bound ( − 0.0857 -0.0857 ) clears the margin, establishing non-inferiority; sensitivity analyses at 5 and 7.5 points remain inconclusive, and the verdict also holds at 15 points. The 23-of-36 valid strict-COV cells and the 35 CFE clusters are explicitly different analysis collections: the former retains only fully measured cells, whereas the latter additionally admits the protocol’s per-family fallback judgments, so the larger CFE count does not contradict the smaller COV count, and the 35 clusters are instance-level pairings between TaskVM and Direct-CUA, not a separate task set.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，表3中报告的非劣效性分析是冻结波次裁决后计算出的修正协议版本。 早期草案将 skills-ON 和 skills-OFF 波次相互比较，但结果尚无定论；修正后的分析遵循评估协议，在合同忠实执行方面，于单个波次内将 TaskVM 与其最强的基线模型进行比较，配对35个任务簇，并以固定种子进行10,000次重采样。 在我们评估协议中指定的10个百分点的边际下，单侧95%的下限（−0.0857）超过了该边际，从而确立了非劣效性；在5和7.5个百分点下的敏感性分析结果尚无定论，而在15个百分点下结论依然成立。 36个有效严格-COV单元格中的23个以及35个CFE簇是明确不同的分析集合：前者仅保留完全测量的单元格，而后者还包含了协议中每个家庭的备用判断，因此较大的CFE数量并不与较小的COV数量矛盾；这35个簇是TaskVM与Direct-CUA之间的实例级配对，而非一个独立的任务集。

paragraphs.en: This appendix positions TaskVM among representative interactive agent systems along one organizing axis: the primary object each interface asks the user to govern. For each system we trace the consequences of that choice, namely what a user edit commits the system to, what counts as completion, and what recovery can mean. These are differences in kind, not rankings: the rows are not benchmarked under a shared protocol, and each cell characterizes the system as presented by its authors; where a column falls outside a system’s reported model, we mark it as such rather than implying incapability.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录将 TaskVM 置于一系列具有代表性的交互式智能体系统之中，并沿一条组织轴进行排列：即每个界面要求用户管理的主要对象。 对于每个系统，我们都会追溯这一选择所带来的后果，即用户的编辑会使系统承担哪些义务，何种状态才算完成，以及恢复可能意味着什么。 这些是种类上的差异，而非排名：各行并非依据统一的标准协议进行基准测试，每个单元格都反映了作者所描述的系统特性；若某一列超出了系统所报告的模式范围，我们会明确标注，而非暗示其存在能力不足。

sents.en: For each system we trace the consequences of that choice, namely what a user edit commits the system to, what counts as completion, and what recovery can mean.

sents.en: These are differences in kind, not rankings: the rows are not benchmarked under a shared protocol, and each cell characterizes the system as presented by its authors; where a column falls outside a system’s reported model, we mark it as such rather than implying incapability.

paragraphs.en: Table 9 specifies the full Stage 2 battery: four counterbalanced task pairs, each pair sharing one governance archetype across two surfaces. paragraphs.zh: 表9详细说明了完整的第二阶段电池：四个经过平衡配对的实验任务对，每对任务在两个界面中共享一个治理原型。 实验者在所示触发点通过“奥兹巫师”重播协议执行了任务中间事件；在两种界面条件下，均重播了相同的事件序列、时间点和错误表现。 每位参与者完成了每种条件下八个任务中的三个；读写探针按照确定性平衡调度分配给各个任务槽（每位参与者在各分支中使用的探针类型记录在会话日志中）。 所有联系人名称均为离线模拟器的虚拟实体。

paragraphs.en: To protect participant privacy, the anonymized archive retains per-episode runtime counters (goal formulation, status, model-call count) rather than complete GUI interaction traces, and some open-ended search terms typed by participants are withheld entirely. We therefore report Stage 3 usage in aggregate (Table 10 ) instead of as per-task transcripts, and point readers to the open-ended responses (Table 11 ) for what participants themselves chose to disclose about their tasks. Per-episode success is not adjudicated (Stage 3 embedded no probes and no per-task ground truth). Model calls are the LLM invocations attributed to an episode by the runtime ledger; application and contact names appearing anywhere in the study are fictional entities of the offline simulator.
paragraphs.zh: 为保护参与者的隐私，匿名化档案保留了每轮运行的计数器（目标构建、状态、模型调用次数），而非完整的 GUI 交互记录，同时完全未保留参与者输入的部分开放式搜索术语。 因此，我们以汇总形式报告第 3 阶段的使用情况（表 10），而非按任务分列的转录记录；关于参与者自行选择披露的任务信息，请读者参考开放式回答（表 11）。 每轮的成功与否并未经过判定（第 3 阶段未嵌入任何探针或任务级基准事实）。 模型调用是指运行日志中归属于某一轮的 LLM 调用；研究中出现的任何应用程序和联系人名称均为离线模拟器的虚构实体。

paragraphs.en: Diversity is visible at the aggregate level. The fourteen participants differ markedly in how they used the open session: total model calls span 3 to 149 per participant (median 52.5), episodes span 1 to 4 (median 3), and tasks touched five distinct application surfaces across the cohort (messaging: 11 participants; social feed: 7; video platform: 4; music: 3; content community: 2). An independence audit confirmed that no two participants produced an identical episode sequence: even where two participants issued a textually identical goal, the runs differ in status, timing, and model-call counts (e.g., 3, 41, 46, 50, 63, and 73 calls on six runs of one shared formulation).
paragraphs.zh: 多样性在聚合层面清晰可见。 十四名参与者在开放环节的使用方式上差异显著：每位参与者的模型调用总数介于 3 到 149 次之间（中位数为 52.5），流程数介于 1 到 4 个之间（中位数为 3），而整个群体涉及了五个不同的应用界面（消息传递：11 名参与者；社交动态：7 名；视频平台：4 名；音乐：3 名；内容社区：2 名）。 一项独立性审计证实，没有任何两名参与者生成过完全相同的流程序列：即使有两名参与者提出了文字上完全一致的目标，他们的运行过程在状态、时机和模型调用次数上仍存在差异（例如，针对同一套方案进行的六次运行中，模型调用次数分别为 3、41、46、50、63 和 73 次）。

sents.en: Diversity is visible at the aggregate level.

paragraphs.en: Read probes were embedded in drift-triggered trials: three multiple-choice questions per probe covering committed effects, the effective goal, and governance facts, drawn from a frozen probe bank (per-task options and answer keys frozen before data collection; scoring = exact key match per question), preceded by a single 0–100 confidence rating for the whole probe. Write probes scored the participant’s own intervention at the scripting boundary and at trial end against the frozen expectation for that task (both endpoints recorded per participant per arm).
paragraphs.zh: 阅读探针被嵌入到漂移触发的试验中：每个探针包含三道选择题，分别涉及已确定的影响、有效目标以及治理事实，这些问题均取自一个固定的探针库（每个任务的选项和答案键在数据收集前已固定；评分 = 每道题与标准答案完全匹配），在此之前，参与者需对整个探针给出一个 0–100 分的信心度评分。 写作探针则用于评估参与者在脚本边界以及试验结束时所进行的自身干预，并与该任务对应的固定预期进行比较（每位参与者每个分支的两个时间点均被记录）。

sents.en: Read probes were embedded in drift-triggered trials: three multiple-choice questions per probe covering committed effects, the effective goal, and governance facts, drawn from a frozen probe bank (per-task options and answer keys frozen before data collection; scoring = exact key match per question), preceded by a single 0–100 confidence rating for the whole probe.
sents.zh: 阅读探针被嵌入到漂移触发的试验中：每个探针包含三道选择题，分别涉及已确定的影响、有效目标以及治理事实，这些问题均取自一个固定的探针库（每个任务的选项和答案键在数据收集前已固定；评分 = 每道题与标准答案完全匹配），在此之前，参与者需对整个探针给出一个 0–100 分的信心度评分。

sents.en: Write probes scored the participant’s own intervention at the scripting boundary and at trial end against the frozen expectation for that task (both endpoints recorded per participant per arm).
sents.zh: 写作探针则用于评估参与者在脚本边界以及试验结束时所进行的自身干预，并与该任务对应的固定预期进行比较（每位参与者每个分支的两个时间点均被记录）。

paragraphs.en: In all stages the user-facing runtime observes only rendered pixels and emits standard GUI gestures; oracle-only capabilities (state resets, internal-state reads, deterministic event injection) are confined to an isolated evaluation harness and are never exposed to the interactive session, as detailed in the prototype section. Per-trial manifests record model identity, per-role call counts, and wall time; frozen artifacts per instance are retained in the consolidated archive cited in Section 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 在所有阶段中，面向用户的运行时仅观察渲染后的像素，并输出标准的 GUI 手势；而仅限“神谕”使用的功能（状态重置、内部状态读取、确定性事件注入）则被限制在独立的评估框架内，绝不会暴露给交互式会话，具体细节见原型部分。 每次试验的日志会记录模型身份、各角色的调用次数以及实际耗时；每个实例的固化产物会被保留在第 5 节引用的综合存档中。

paragraphs.en: Demographic and background information was collected after the main study through two voluntary channels. (i) At compensation time, participants could provide identifying contact information together with self-reported gender, age, and affiliation; 36 of the 37 completers did so, and one (P08) declined all background collection. (ii) On 2026-09-12 we additionally administered a five-item background questionnaire (field of study; professional background related to AI agents; usage frequency of three classes of AI systems; AI products used; purposes of use) as a web page gated by roster name verification; 35 of the 37 completers answered it, one (P32) submitted compensation information but declined the questionnaire. The questionnaire was administered in Chinese; a faithful English transcription is included in the supplementary material, and Table 15 maps the dataset’s option codes to the original wording. No information in this appendix was inferred from names, photos, or researcher impressions; undeclared fields are reported as such.
paragraphs.zh: 主要研究结束后，通过两个自愿渠道收集了人口统计学信息和背景信息。 (i) 在补偿阶段，参与者可以提供身份识别的联系方式以及自我报告的性别、年龄和所属机构；37名完成者中有36人提供了这些信息，而一人（P08）拒绝提供所有背景信息。 (ii) 2026年9月12日，我们还通过一个需验证名单名称才能访问的网页，额外发放了一份包含五个问题的背景问卷（研究领域；与AI智能体相关的专业背景；三类AI系统的使用频率；使用的AI产品；使用目的）；37名完成者中有35人填写了该问卷，一人（P32）提交了补偿信息但拒绝填写问卷。 该问卷以中文发放；其忠实的英文转录版本已包含在补充材料中，表15则将该数据集的选项代码与原始表述进行了对应。 本附录中的任何信息均未从姓名、照片或研究人员的印象中进行推断；未声明的字段均如实报告。

paragraphs.en: A majority of participants (20/35) classified themselves into CS/AI disciplines, but the questionnaire deliberately separated disciplinary labels from agent-specific expertise, and the two diverge sharply. Most CS/AI-classified participants specialize in areas whose day-to-day work does not involve building or evaluating GUI agents, such as computer vision, embodied AI, computer architecture, NLP post-training, signal processing, and similar fields. Asked directly about professional background with agents, only 2/35 (5.7%) reported direct experience with computer-use/GUI agents, 5/35 reported agent (but not GUI-agent) backgrounds, 12/35 reported AI work unrelated to agents, and 16/35 reported no or only limited professional exposure to AI agents at all. Usage told the same story: 14/35 (40%) had never used a GUI agent or had tried one only once or twice before the study. The sample is therefore best characterized as technically literate but predominantly novice with respect to GUI agents , the population for which governance interfaces must work.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数参与者（20/35）将自己归入计算机科学/人工智能领域，但问卷有意将学科标签与智能体相关的专业技能区分开来，而这两者存在显著差异。 大多数被归类为计算机科学/人工智能领域的参与者，其日常工作并不涉及构建或评估图形用户界面（GUI）智能体，例如计算机视觉、具身人工智能、计算机体系结构、自然语言处理后训练、信号处理及类似领域。 当直接询问其是否与智能体相关的专业背景时，仅有2/35人（5.7%）表示有直接使用计算机/图形用户界面智能体的经验；5/35人表示有智能体相关背景（但非GUI智能体）；12/35人从事与智能体无关的人工智能工作；另有16/35人表示完全未接触过人工智能智能体，或仅有过有限接触。 使用情况也印证了这一点：14/35人（40%）从未使用过图形用户界面智能体，或在研究前仅尝试过一次或两次。 因此，该样本群体最准确的描述是：具备技术知识，但在图形用户界面智能体方面多数为新手——而治理界面正是需要面向这一群体设计的。

paragraphs.en: Participants’ existing AI usage was mainstream rather than specialist. The most-used products were conversational assistants (ChatGPT 31/35, DeepSeek 24, Claude 19, Gemini 18); coding assistants were common (Claude Code 13, GitHub Copilot 6, other coding agents 6, Cursor 3), while research-style tools (6), general-purpose agents (5), and any standalone computer-use/GUI-agent product (only 2) were rare. Reported purposes centered on research (27/35), coding (16), learning (15), and writing (10); delegating a multi-step task to an agent for autonomous completion was reported by only one participant. One additional participant reported essentially no AI use.
paragraphs.zh: 参与者的现有 AI 使用方式属于主流应用，而非专业领域。 使用最频繁的产品是对话助手（ChatGPT 31/35、DeepSeek 24、Claude 19、Gemini 18）；编程助手也较为常见（Claude Code 13、GitHub Copilot 6、其他编程智能体 6、Cursor 3），而研究类工具（6）、通用型智能体（5）以及任何独立的计算机操作/GUI 智能体产品（仅 2）则较为罕见。 报告的使用目的主要集中在研究（27/35）、编程（16）、学习（15）和写作（10）；仅有 1 位参与者表示曾将多步骤任务委托给智能体以实现自主完成。 另有 1 位参与者表示基本没有使用 AI。

paragraphs.en: Table 16 lists every completer’s self-reported information. Field categories follow the questionnaire’s own option wording. Note in particular that the code math corresponded to “Mathematics / Statistics / Physics and other basic sciences,” so basic-science majors (e.g., physics) appear under that label; the parenthesized detail is the participant’s own free-text specialization, translated. Category codes follow the raw submission log; for one participant (P13) the compensation copy and the submission log differ on the category code ( other vs. math ), and we report the submission log.
paragraphs.zh: 表 16 列出了每位完成者的自我报告信息。 字段类别遵循问卷本身的选项措辞。 尤其需要注意的是，代码中的“Math”对应“数学/统计学/物理学及其他基础科学”，因此基础科学专业（例如物理学）会显示在该标签下；括号内的详细信息是参与者自行填写的专业方向，并经过翻译。 类别代码遵循原始提交记录；对于一名参与者（P13），补偿记录与提交记录中的类别代码存在差异（“其他” vs. “数学”），我们在此报告提交记录中的内容。
